VBA MACRO clsMarket.cls 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/clsMarket'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Public Name As String                       'name of the market = ID
Public LimitReset As String                 '= "day" or "business day"
Public numBDForExposure As Integer          'number of business days for exposure calculation that need to be considered (t0+?)
Public Flag_Auction As Integer               'Flag to see that the info about payment is available before DCP can use the limit of the last business day
Public calName As String                    'name of the corresponding business day calendar
Public Flag_Separate_TD_Calendar As Integer 'flag to see that market has a separate trading day calendar (no trading each calendar day)
Public MarketCurrency As String             'currency
Public SpecialMarket As String


' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateMarket
' Purpose: get Market information out of matrix (j-th row)
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter InputMatrix (Variant):
' Parameter j (Integer):
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CreateMarket(InputMatrix As Variant, j As Integer)
Dim Test As Integer, _
    k As Integer
    
    'test if no information is missing
    Test = 0
    For k = 1 To UBound(InputMatrix, 2) - 1      ' Inputmatrix is the conten of the market sheet
        If InputMatrix(j, k) = vbNullString Then
            Test = 1
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
    
    'get informations
    If Test = 0 Then
        Name = InputMatrix(j, 1)
        LimitReset = InputMatrix(j, 2)
        numBDForExposure = InputMatrix(j, 3)
        Flag_Auction = InputMatrix(j, 4)
        MarketCurrency = InputMatrix(j, 5)
        calName = InputMatrix(j, 6)
        Flag_Separate_TD_Calendar = InputMatrix(j, 7)
    End If
    
End Sub

VBA MACRO a4Start.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/a4Start'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Option Private Module

Public InputCalc As clsInputCalcClass
Public numBaseAdjustments As Integer
Public CurrentMacro As String, _
       StatusCalculation As String

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: StartSub_Calculation
' Purpose: This is the method which is called by pushing the button in the sheet 'start'
' Caller: button in the sheet 'start'
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub StartSub_Calculation()

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Call StartCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: StartCalc
' Purpose: The method starts the calculation from pushing the start-sheet button
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub StartCalc()
Dim DCP As clssettingDCP
    
    'delete current information
    Set ECCCalendar = Nothing
    
    ' prepare and test Data for calculation
    Call PrepareCalculation
        
    'get setting for DCP
    Set DCP = New clssettingDCP
    Call DCP.GetInfoDCP
    
    'create exposure scenarios
    Call GetExposureScenarios(InputCalc.StartDate, InputCalc.EndDate)
    
    'use given Collateral as input
    Call CalcScenariosForDCP(DCP)
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: PrepareCalculation
' Purpose: The method starts and executes the calendar handling
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrepareCalculation()

    'clear output
    ShtOutput.Activate
    Range(Cells(4, 1), Cells(4, 11)).Select
    Range(Selection, Selection.End(xlDown)).ClearContents
    Range("A4").Select
    
    'create ECC Calendar
    Call CreateECCCalendar
    'all business day calendars
    Call CreateCalendarCol
    
    'read input data for calculation
    Set InputCalc = New clsInputCalcClass
    Call InputCalc.Initiate
    
End Sub

VBA MACRO Calendars.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Calendars'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Option Private Module

Public ECCCalendar As clsCalendar
Public colExposureScenarios As Collection
Public colCalendars As Collection

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateECCCalendar
' Purpose: create object Calendar 'ECC'
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CreateECCCalendar()

    Set ECCCalendar = New clsCalendar
    Call ECCCalendar.CreateCalendar("ECC")

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateCalendarCol
' Purpose: The method creates a collection for calendar
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CreateCalendarCol()
Dim cal As clsCalendar

    Set colCalendars = New Collection
      
    'create object for ECC-calendar
    Set cal = New clsCalendar
    Call cal.CreateCalendar("ECC")
    'add to collection
    colCalendars.Add cal, "ECC"
    
    'create object for GBP-calendar
    Set cal = New clsCalendar
    Call cal.CreateCalendar("ECC-GBP")
    'add to collection
    colCalendars.Add cal, "ECC-GBP"
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetExposureScenarios
' Purpose: create all availabe Market exposure scenarios for the current day t0 (until t0+3) and put them into Collection
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter StartDate (Date): start of period
' Parameter EndDate (Date): end of period
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub GetExposureScenarios(StartDate As Date, EndDate As Date)
Dim t As Date, _
    t1 As Date
Dim colBD1 As Collection, _
    colScenariosForBD As Collection
Dim test2 As Integer, _
    NBD As Integer
    
    'Collection for results
    Set colExposureScenarios = New Collection
    
    Set colScenariosForBD = New Collection
    Set colScenariosForBD = CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD(StartDate)
       
    'add first scenario collection
    colExposureScenarios.Add colScenariosForBD, CStr(StartDate)
        
    For t = StartDate + 1 To EndDate
                   
        'only for ECC Business Dates
        If ECCCalendar.GetBDIndex(t) <> 0 Then
            
            'create
            Set colBD1 = New Collection
            Set colBD1 = CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD(t)
            'is it a valid scenario?
            If colBD1.Count = InputCalc.DCPPrefNumMarkets Then
                If InputCalc.CalcType = 0 Then
                    'compare to already existing scenarios
                    test2 = 0
                    colExposureScenarios.Add colBD1, CStr(t)
                Else
                    'add each day to collection
                    colExposureScenarios.Add colBD1, CStr(t)
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD
' Purpose: The method fills a collection for scenarios with the defned markets
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter StartDate (Date): The start date to consider
' Return Type: Collection
' Author: Kathrin Kohutek
' Changed: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 22.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD(StartDate As Date) As Collection
Dim MName As String, _
    calName As String
Dim scenario As clsExposureScenario
Dim MarketObj As clsMarket
Dim j As Integer, _
    numBD As Integer, _
    GBPFlag As Integer

    Set CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD = New Collection
    
    For j = 1 To InputCalc.DCPPrefNumMarkets
        
        Set MarketObj = InputCalc.colMarkets(InputCalc.DCPPreferences(j, 1))
        MName = MarketObj.Name
        numBD = MarketObj.numBDForExposure
        calName = MarketObj.calName
            
        Set scenario = New clsExposureScenario
              
        GBPFlag = IIf(MarketObj.calName = "ECC" And MarketObj.MarketCurrency = POUND, 1, 0)
        Call scenario.Fill(calName, StartDate, numBD, GBPFlag)
        
        'add to collection, if valid scenario
        If scenario.ValidFlag = 1 Then
            CreateCollection_ExposureScenariosForBD.Add scenario, MName
        End If
        
    Next

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: DeleteDate
' Purpose: The procedure contains algorithm for deleting a date from the listbox as well as from the sheet
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter DateColumn (Integer): The affected column in the form and the appropriate column in sheet calendar
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 03.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub DeleteDate(DateColumn As Integer)
Dim ThisCol As String, _
    ThisRow As String, _
    RangeToDeleteAddress As String, _
    sFind As String, _
    SourceRange As String, _
    NameOfTheControl As String
Dim ThisControl As Control
Dim rFound As Range
Dim cell_add As Variant

    NameOfTheControl = "lstSpecMarket0" & CStr(DateColumn)
    Set ThisControl = frmConfig.Controls(NameOfTheControl)
    Select Case ThisControl.value
        Case Is <> vbNullString
            sFind = Format(ThisControl, Fmt.LocalFormat)
            SourceRange = Mid(ThisControl.RowSource, 11)
            With ShtCalendar
                Set rFound = .Range(SourceRange).Find(What:=sFind, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False)
                If rFound Is Nothing Then
                    Set rFound = .Range(SourceRange).Find(What:=CDate(sFind), LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False)
                End If
                If Not rFound Is Nothing Then
                    cell_add = Split(rFound.Address, "$")
                    ThisCol = cell_add(1)
                    ThisRow = cell_add(2)
                    RangeToDeleteAddress = ThisCol & ThisRow
                End If
                
                If Not rFound Is Nothing Then
                    Intersect(.Range(RangeToDeleteAddress), .Range(ThisControl.RowSource)).Delete Shift:=xlUp
                End If
            End With
        Case Else: Exit Sub
    End Select
        
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: AddNewDate
' Purpose: The procedure contains algorithm for adding a new data to the listbox as well as to the sheet
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter DateColumn (Integer): The affected column in the form and the appropriate column in the sheet
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 03.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub AddNewDate(DateColumn As Integer)
Dim ColumnLetter As String, _
    RangeAddress As String, _
    strNextLine As String, _
    NameOfTheControl As String
Dim ThisControl As Control
Dim ThisCollection As Collection

    NameOfTheControl = "txtSpecMarket0" & CStr(DateColumn)
    Set ThisControl = frmConfig.Controls(NameOfTheControl)
    If Not IsDate(ThisControl.value) Then
        MsgBox "The value " & ThisControl.value & " is not a date, please enter another one!", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
                                                
    Select Case DateColumn
        Case 1: Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket01
                ColumnLetter = "G": RangeAddress = "G4:G"
        Case 2: Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket02
                ColumnLetter = "H": RangeAddress = "H4:H"
        Case 3: Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket03
                ColumnLetter = "I": RangeAddress = "I4:I"
                If Not Check4TueOrThu(ThisControl.value) Then
                    Exit Sub
                End If
        Case 4: Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket04
                ColumnLetter = "J": RangeAddress = "J4:J"
                                                           
        Case 5: Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket05
                ColumnLetter = "K": RangeAddress = "K4:K"
                                                           
        Case 6 To 20
                Set ThisCollection = colSpecialMarket06
                Dim CCol As String
                CCol = Col_Letter(DateColumn)
                ColumnLetter = CCol: RangeAddress = CCol & "4:" & CCol
    End Select
    
    If ExistsInCollection(ThisCollection, ThisControl.value) Then
        MsgBox ("This value exists already in the list of trading dates!")
    Else
        With ShtCalendar
            strNextLine = CStr(.Range(ColumnLetter & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row + 1)
            .Range(ColumnLetter & strNextLine).value = CDate(ThisControl.value)
            .Range(ColumnLetter & strNextLine).NumberFormat = "m/d/yyyy"
            Call SortRange(RangeAddress & strNextLine)
            Call FillListbox(ShtCalendar, RangeAddress)
        End With
    End If
        
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: SortRange
' Purpose: The method sorts the data in the sheet calendar for the appropriate market
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Parameter RangeAdress (String): The Range to sort
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 25.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub SortRange(RangeAdress As String)

    Range(RangeAdress).Select
    
    With ShtCalendar.Sort
        .SortFields.Clear
        .SortFields.Add2 key:=Range(RangeAdress), _
                      SortOn:=xlSortOnValues, _
                       Order:=xlAscending, _
                  DataOption:=xlSortNormal
        .SetRange Range(RangeAdress)
        .Header = xlNo
        .MatchCase = False
        .Orientation = xlTopToBottom
        .SortMethod = xlPinYin
        .Apply
    End With
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: ShowOrHideInfos
' Purpose: the method shows or hides information in the detail area if the appropriate checkbox is ticked ort not
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter HDNb (Integer): the number of control
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 25.07.2024
' Change: 24.04.25: new variable strHDNb with 1 conversion instead of 6 times a conversion
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub ShowOrHideInfos(HDNb As Integer)
Dim strHDNb As String
    strHDNb = Format(HDNb, "00")
    With frmConfig
        .Controls("txtCE" & strHDNb).Visible = .Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value
        .Controls("lblCE" & strHDNb).Visible = .Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value
        If HDNb > CInt(MAXSTDHDAY) Then
            .Controls("txtCE" & strHDNb).value = .Controls("txtHowToCalc" & strHDNb).value
        End If
    End With
        
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: EditCalendarDate
' Purpose: The procedure contains algorithm for adding a new data to the info panel/textbox as well as to the sheet
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter Item number
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 03.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub EditCalendarDate(item As Control)
Dim ItemNb As String, _
    NameListCtrl As String, _
    NamePanelCtrl As String
Dim TheListControl As Control
Dim ThePanelControl As Control

    If Not IsDate(item.value) Then
        MsgBox "The value " & item.value & " is not a date, please enter another one!", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ItemNb = Right(item.Name, 2)
    NameListCtrl = "txtHowToCalc" & CStr(ItemNb)
    NamePanelCtrl = "txtCE" & CStr(ItemNb)
        
    Set TheListControl = frmConfig.Controls(NameListCtrl)
    Set ThePanelControl = frmConfig.Controls(NamePanelCtrl)
    
    If Mid(item.Name, 4, 1) = "H" Then    ' Name of the control is txt_H_owToCalc
        ThePanelControl.value = TheListControl.value
    Else
        TheListControl.value = ThePanelControl.value
    End If
    
    Set TheListControl = Nothing
    Set ThePanelControl = Nothing
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: Check4TueOrThu
' Purpose: The method checks a date, if it's on a Tuesday or a Thursday
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Private
' Parameter TheDate (String): The date to evaluate
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 06.08.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function Check4TueOrThu(theDate As String) As Boolean
Dim DateToEvaluate As Date
Dim Msg As Byte

    ' init the function with FALSE
    Check4TueOrThu = False
    ' The date to check
    DateToEvaluate = CDate(theDate)
    
    ' Is this date Tuesday or Thursday?
    If Weekday(DateToEvaluate) = vbTuesday Or _
        Weekday(DateToEvaluate) = vbThursday Then
        ' Indeed, it's ok :-) - the result of this function is TRUE
        Check4TueOrThu = True
    Else
        ' Huhu - a wrong date ... we signalize this the user with a yello textbox
        frmConfig.txtSpecMarket03.BackColor = vbYellow
        ' The information in the messagebox, so the user can decide
        Msg = MsgBox("The market for which you've entered this date allows only trading dates on Tuesday or Thursday." & vbCrLf & _
               "The date, which you've selected, is on " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(CDate(theDate)) & "." & vbCrLf & _
               "Do you want to keep this day?", vbYesNo, "Wrong date")
               
        If Msg = vbYes Then
            ' For the user it's ok, nothing happend, result of the function is TRUE
            Check4TueOrThu = True
            frmConfig.txtSpecMarket03.BackColor = vbWhite
        Else
            ' The user needs to reenter the value, the result of the function keeps on FALSE
            If Msg = vbNo Then
            With frmConfig.txtSpecMarket03
                .value = vbNullString
                .BackColor = vbWhite
            End With
            End If
        End If
    End If
    
End Function

VBA MACRO clsExposureScenario.cls 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/clsExposureScenario'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Public t0 As Date                   'start date
Public calName As String            'Name of the corresponding calendar
Public Input_numBD As Integer       'number of business days (Input)
Public numBD As Integer             'number business days in scenario without t0 (t0+?)
Public numECCBD As Integer             'number business days in scenario without t0 (t0+?)
Public numDays As Integer           'number calendar days in scenario without t0
Public numNBD As Integer            'number non-business days in scenario
Public numPD As Integer             'number of payment days in scenario without t0
Public ListBD As Variant            'List (0 to numBD) of all business dates in scenario
Public ListDays As Variant          'List (0 to numDays) of all calendar dates in scenario
'Public ListNBD As Variant           'List (1 to numNBD) of all business dates in scenario
Public BDFlags As Variant           'List (0..numDays) which contains a Flag (0 or 1) for NBD or BD
Public ListGroups As Variant        'List (0..numDays) that connects the calendar day with the corresponding business day
Public PaymentGBPFlags As Variant   'List (0..numDays) which contains a Flag (0 or 1) to see whether payment in GBP is possible
Public ValidFlag As Integer         'Flag to see whether scenario can be used

Public ListECCBD As Variant            'List (0 to numBD) of all ECC business dates in scenario
Public ECCBDFlags As Variant           'List (0..numDays) which contains a Flag (0 or 1) for NBD or BD according to ECC calendar

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: Fill
' Purpose: create sub scenario from calendar starting at t0 and include the next n business days
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter InputCalName (String): Name of the calendar
' Parameter InputDate (Date): The date
' Parameter n (Integer): Number of business days
' Parameter GBPPaymentFlag (Integer): if GBPPaymentFlag=1, then payment should be possible on the last business day (scenario will be extended if not)
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 30.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Fill(InputCalName As String, InputDate As Date, n As Integer, GBPPaymentFlag As Integer)
Dim index_t0 As Integer, _
    j As Integer, _
    ECCBD As Integer, _
    BD As Integer, _
    NBD As Integer
Dim cal As clsCalendar, _
    calECC As clsCalendar

    Set cal = colCalendars(InputCalName)
    Set calECC = colCalendars("ECC")
    
    t0 = InputDate
    calName = cal.Name
    Input_numBD = n
    
    'initiate valid status
    ValidFlag = 1
    
    'where stands t0?
    index_t0 = t0 - cal.StartDate + 1
    'included in the calendar?
    If index_t0 < 1 Then
        ValidFlag = 0
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    'scenarios are created only for ECC business days --> point of discussion !!!!!!
    If ECCCalendar.GetBDIndex(t0) = 0 Then
        ValidFlag = 0
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    'get number of Days (without t0), so that we have n Business/Payment Days (without t0)
    numDays = 0
    numBD = 0
    numPD = 0
    numECCBD = 0
    Do While numBD < n
        'enough data in calendar?
        If index_t0 < UBound(cal.BDFlag, 1) Then
            numDays = numDays + 1
            If cal.BDFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 1 Then
                numBD = numBD + 1
                If cal.PaymentGBPFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 1 Then
                    numPD = numPD + 1
                End If
            End If
            If calECC.BDFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 1 Then
                numECCBD = numECCBD + 1
            End If
        Else
            ValidFlag = 0
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Loop
    'check that last business day is payment day
    If GBPPaymentFlag = 1 Then
        Do While cal.PaymentGBPFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 0
            'enough data in calendar?
            If index_t0 < UBound(cal.BDFlag, 1) Then
                numDays = numDays + 1
                If cal.BDFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 1 Then
                    numBD = numBD + 1
                    If cal.PaymentGBPFlag(index_t0 + numDays) = 1 Then
                        numPD = numPD + 1
                    End If
                End If
            Else
                ValidFlag = 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
        Loop
    End If
    
    'fill List of dates for Scenario
    numNBD = numDays - numBD
    ReDim ListBD(0 To numBD)
    ReDim ListECCBD(0 To numECCBD)
    'ReDim ListNBD(1 To numNBD)
    ReDim ListDays(0 To numDays)
    ReDim BDFlags(0 To numDays)
    ReDim ECCBDFlags(0 To numDays)
    ReDim ListGroups(0 To numDays)
    ReDim PaymentGBPFlags(0 To numDays)
    
    NBD = 0
    BD = 0
    ECCBD = 0
    For j = 0 To numDays
        ListDays(j) = t0 + j
        ListGroups(j) = ECCBD
        If cal.BDFlag(index_t0 + j) = 1 Then
            ListBD(BD) = cal.Days(index_t0 + j)
            BDFlags(j) = 1
            BD = BD + 1
        Else
            BDFlags(j) = 0
            NBD = NBD + 1
            'ListNBD(nBD) = ListDays(j)
        End If
        If calECC.BDFlag(index_t0 + j) = 1 Then
            ListECCBD(ECCBD) = calECC.Days(index_t0 + j)
            ECCBDFlags(j) = 1
            ECCBD = ECCBD + 1
        Else
            ECCBDFlags(j) = 0
            'nBD = nBD + 1
            'ListNBD(nBD) = ListDays(j)
        End If
        
        If cal.PaymentGBPFlag(index_t0 + j) = 1 Then
            PaymentGBPFlags(j) = 1
        Else
            PaymentGBPFlags(j) = 0
        End If
    Next
    
    If t0 = DateSerial(2023, 5, 5) Then
        t0 = t0
    End If
    
End Sub

VBA MACRO Tools.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Tools'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Option Private Module

Function GetColumnAsList(a As Variant, k As Integer, Start As Integer) As Variant
' a is a copy of the array Preferences
' List is the array of market names
Dim List As Variant, _
    j As Variant
    
    ReDim List(Start To (UBound(a, 1) + Start - 1))
    For j = Start To UBound(a, 1) + Start - 1
        List(j) = a(j - Start + 1, k)
    Next
    
    GetColumnAsList = List       ' List is the array of market names

End Function

Function TransformListForOutput(List As Variant) As Variant
Dim a As Variant, _
    j As Variant
    
    ReDim a(LBound(List, 1) To UBound(List, 1), 1 To 1)
    For j = LBound(List, 1) To UBound(List, 1)
         a(j, 1) = List(j)
    Next
    
    TransformListForOutput = a

End Function


Function NumberDisjunctElementsInList(List As Variant) As Integer
Dim colElements As Collection
Dim text As Variant
Dim num As Integer, _
    j As Integer, _
    k As Integer
    
    num = 0
    Set colElements = New Collection
    
    For j = LBound(List, 1) To UBound(List, 1)
        
        k = 0
        For Each text In colElements
            If text = CStr(List(j)) Then
                k = 1
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        
        If k = 0 Then
            colElements.Add CStr(List(j))
            num = num + 1
        End If
    Next
    
    NumberDisjunctElementsInList = num

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: TransformCollectionToMatrix
' Purpose: transforms a collection of matrices to one matrix,
'          all elements of collection have to have the same number of columns
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter col (Collection): the collection to transform
' Return Type: Variant
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function TransformCollectionToMatrix(Col As Collection) As Variant
Dim j As Integer, _
    k As Integer, _
    L As Integer, _
    a As Variant, _
    m As Integer, _
    n As Integer, _
    B As Variant
            
    'get Dimension of A
    B = Col(1)
    m = UBound(B, 2)
    n = 0
    For j = 1 To Col.Count
        B = Col(j)
        n = n + UBound(B, 1)
    Next
    ReDim a(1 To n, 1 To m)
    
    'fill
    n = 0
    For j = 1 To Col.Count
        B = Col(j)
        For L = 1 To UBound(B, 1)
            For k = 1 To m
                a(n + L, k) = B(L, k)
            Next
        Next
        n = n + UBound(B, 1)
    Next
    
    TransformCollectionToMatrix = a

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: TransposeMatrix
' Purpose: NOT USED FROM VBA * The method transposes the variable a into a matrix
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter a (Variant):
' Return Type: Variant
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function TransposeMatrix(a As Variant) As Variant
Dim B As Variant
Dim n1 As Integer, _
    n2 As Integer, _
    m1 As Integer, _
    m2 As Integer, _
    j As Integer, _
    k As Integer
    
    'dimensions
    n1 = LBound(a, 1)
    m1 = LBound(a, 2)
    n2 = UBound(a, 1)
    m2 = UBound(a, 2)
    
    'initialize
    ReDim B(m1 To m2, n1 To n2)
    For j = m1 To m2
        For k = n1 To n2
            B(j, k) = a(k, j)
        Next
    Next
    
    TransposeMatrix = B

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: ExistsInCollection
' Purpose: the method checks if a key exists in a collection
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter col (Collection): name of the collection
' Parameter key (Variant): name of the key
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function ExistsInCollection(Col As Collection, key As Variant) As Boolean
Dim a
    
   ExistsInCollection = True

   On Error GoTo NotFound
     a = Col.item(key)
   On Error GoTo 0
   Exit Function
   
NotFound:
   ExistsInCollection = False
   
End Function

Public Function IsLoaded(formName As String) As Boolean
Dim frm As Object
        
    For Each frm In VBA.UserForms
        If frm.Name = formName Then
            IsLoaded = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next frm
    IsLoaded = False
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: IsDateInCollection
' Purpose: The function checks, if a date is member of a collection of dates
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter col (Collection): the collection with the date values
' Parameter targetDate (Date): the date, which we are looking for in the collection
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 26.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function IsDateInCollection(Col As Collection, targetDate As Date) As Boolean
Dim i As Integer
Dim datum As Date

    IsDateInCollection = False
    For i = 1 To Col.Count
        datum = Col(i)
        If datum = targetDate Then
            IsDateInCollection = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

End Function

Public Function TheHolidayIs(datDate As Date) As String
Dim TheYear As Integer
Dim tmpText

    TheYear = Year(datDate)
    With HolidayDateDict.item(TheYear)
        If .NewYearsDay = datDate Then tmpText = "New year"
        If .GoodFriday = datDate Then tmpText = "Good Friday"
        If .EasterMonday = datDate Then tmpText = "Easter Monday"
        If .labourDay = datDate Then tmpText = "Labour Day"
        If .EarlyMayBankHoliday = datDate Then tmpText = "Early May bank holiday from GB"
        If .SpringBankHoliday = datDate Then tmpText = "Spring bank holiday from GB"
        If .SummerBankHoliday = datDate Then tmpText = "Summer bank holiday from GB"
        If .ChristmasDay = datDate Then tmpText = "Christmas"
        If .BoxingDay = datDate Then tmpText = "Boxing day"
        If .SubstituteDay1 = datDate Then tmpText = "Substitue day, if in GB Christmas day is a Saturday or Sunday then the following Monday becomes a holiday"
        If .SubstituteDay2 = datDate Then tmpText = "Substitue day, if in GB Christmas day is a Saturday or Sunday then the following Monday becomes a holiday"
        If .CustHoliday1 = datDate Then tmpText = "Customer specific holiday 1: " & .CustHoliday1Name
        If .CustHoliday2 = datDate Then tmpText = "Customer specific holiday 2: " & .CustHoliday2Name
        If .CustHoliday3 = datDate Then tmpText = "Customer specific holiday 3: " & .CustHoliday3Name
        If .CustHoliday4 = datDate Then tmpText = "Customer specific holiday 4: " & .CustHoliday4Name
        If .CustHoliday5 = datDate Then tmpText = "Customer specific holiday 5: " & .CustHoliday5Name
    End With
    If tmpText <> vbNullString Then
        tmpText = "The " & datDate & " is " & tmpText & ", "
        TheHolidayIs = tmpText
    End If
    
End Function

VBA MACRO clsCalcForMarket.cls 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/clsCalcForMarket'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

'Input
Public MarketObj As clsMarket                              'Market and all its properties
Public scenario As clsExposureScenario             'scenario for business day t0
Public InputBaseValueBDCur As Double            'base limit amount for business days - Input in original currency
Public InputBaseValueNBDCur As Double           'base limit amount for non-business days - Input in original currency
Public InputBaseValueBD As Double               'base limit amount for business days - Input in €
Public InputBaseValueNBD As Double              'base limit amount for non-business days - Input in €

'calculated properties
Public InputValuesDistributed As Variant        'List(1..numDays) where InputBaseValueBDCur and InputBaseValueNBDCur are distributed accordingly
Public BaseValueBD As Double                    'used base limit amount for business days (taking into account collateral)
Public BaseValueNBD As Double                   'used base limit amount for non-business days (taking into account collateral)
Public BaseValuesDistributed As Variant         'List(1..numDays) where BaseValueBD and BaseValueNBD are distributed accordingly
Public BaseLimit As Variant                     'List(1..numDays) of calculated minimal Limits
Public BaseExposure As Double                   'calculated base exposure
Public BaseExposure_MainCur As Double           'calculated base exposure in Main Currency

Public Xrate_Value As Double

'Public LimitOutputValueBD As Double             'LimitValueBDCur after rounding
'Public LimitOutputValueNBD As Double            'LimitValueNBDCur after rounding
'Public LimitOutputValuesDistributed As Variant  'List(1..numDays) where LimitValueBDCur and LimitValueNBDCur are distributed accordingly
Public LimitOutput As Variant                   'LimitOutputValuesDistributed transformed to Limits and with rounding


Sub Initiate(DCP As clssettingDCP, z As Integer, t0 As Date)
Dim colBD As Collection
    
    'Market and corresponding scenario
    Set MarketObj = InputCalc.colMarkets(DCP.ListMarkets(z))
    Set colBD = colExposureScenarios.item(CStr(t0))
    Set scenario = colBD.item(z)
    
    Call DCP.GetInfoDCP
    
    'input for amount needed on bd and nbd
    InputBaseValueBD = DCP.ListBaseValueBD(z)
    InputBaseValueNBD = DCP.ListBaseValueNBD(z)
    InputBaseValueBDCur = DCP.ListInputValueBD(z)
    InputBaseValueNBDCur = DCP.ListInputValueNBD(z)
    
    Xrate_Value = IIf(DCP.Main_Cur <> MarketObj.MarketCurrency, InputCalc.Xrate, 1)
    
    'starting point for calculation
    If InputCalc.Flag_Rounding = 1 Then
        BaseValueBD = Application.RoundUp(InputBaseValueBD, InputCalc.RoundingDigits)
        BaseValueNBD = Application.RoundUp(InputBaseValueNBD, InputCalc.RoundingDigits)
    Else
        BaseValueBD = InputBaseValueBD
        BaseValueNBD = InputBaseValueNBD
    End If
    
End Sub

Sub CalcBaseExposure()
    
    'generate BaseValuesDistributed
    BaseValuesDistributed = DistributeValues(BaseValueBD, BaseValueNBD)
    'calculate Limits
    BaseLimit = TransformToLimits(BaseValueBD, BaseValueNBD, False)
    'calculate Exposure
    BaseExposure = CalcExposure(BaseLimit)
    
    BaseExposure_MainCur = Application.RoundUp(BaseExposure / Xrate_Value, 0)
    
End Sub

Function DistributeValues(ValueBD As Double, ValueNBD As Double) As Variant
Dim Output As Variant, _
    BDFlags As Variant
Dim j As Integer, _
    n As Integer
Dim t As Date

    'Infos from scenario
    'number Days
    n = scenario.numDays
    BDFlags = scenario.BDFlags
    
    'Step 1: every day in the future gets the amount needed
    '-----------------------------------
    ReDim Output(1 To n)
    For j = 1 To n
        t = scenario.ListDays(j)
        If ECCCalendar.IsTradingDay(t, MarketObj.Name) <> 0 Then
            Output(j) = IIf(scenario.BDFlags(j) = 1, ValueBD, ValueNBD)
        Else
            Output(j) = 0
        End If
    Next
    
    DistributeValues = Output
    
End Function


Function TransformToLimits(ValueBD As Double, ValueNBD As Double, WithRounding As Boolean) As Variant
Dim j As Integer, _
    n As Integer
Dim MaxValue As Double, _
    SumValue As Double
Dim Limits As Variant, _
    ListGroups As Variant, _
    ListBD As Variant, _
    ListECCBD As Variant, _
    ListDays As Variant, _
    BDFlags As Variant

    'number Days
    n = scenario.numDays
    
    'Infos from scenario
    ListGroups = scenario.ListGroups
    ListBD = scenario.ListBD
    ListECCBD = scenario.ListECCBD
    ListDays = scenario.ListDays
    BDFlags = scenario.BDFlags
    
    'calculate Max
    MaxValue = IIf(ValueBD > ValueNBD, ValueBD, ValueNBD)
    
    'Step 1: every day in the future gets the amount needed
    '-----------------------------------
    Limits = DistributeValues(ValueBD, ValueNBD)
    
    'Step 2: take into account the LimitReset rule of the Market
    '------------------------------------------------
    If MarketObj.LimitReset = "day" Then
        
        'for daily LimitResets use maximum value
        'for each group seperately
        For j = 1 To n
            'adjustments necessary, if in group more than one day
            If ListGroups(j) >= 1 Then
                If ListECCBD(ListGroups(j)) - ListECCBD(ListGroups(j) - 1) > 1 And BDFlags(ListECCBD(ListGroups(j)) - ListDays(0)) = 1 Then
                    Limits(j) = MaxValue
                End If
            End If
        Next
        
    Else
        'for LimitResets on business days the Limits is the sum
        'for each group (from one business day to the next) seperately
        'if we only have ValueBD and ValueNBD the sum during one group is given by ValueBD+(n-1)*ValueNBD
        'SumValue = ValueBD + (ListBD(1) - ListBD(0) - 1) * ValueBD
        For j = 1 To n
            If ListGroups(j) <> ListGroups(j - 1) Then
                If BDFlags(ListECCBD(ListGroups(j)) - ListDays(0)) = 1 Then
                    SumValue = ValueBD + (ListECCBD(ListGroups(j)) - ListECCBD(ListGroups(j - 1)) - 1) * ValueNBD
                Else
                    SumValue = ValueNBD + (ListECCBD(ListGroups(j)) - ListECCBD(ListGroups(j - 1)) - 1) * ValueNBD
                End If
            End If
            Limits(j) = SumValue
        Next
    End If

    
    'consider rounding
    If WithRounding And InputCalc.Flag_Rounding Then
        For j = 1 To n
            Limits(j) = Application.RoundDown(Limits(j), InputCalc.RoundingDigits)
        Next
    End If
    
    TransformToLimits = Limits

End Function

Function CalcExposure(Limits As Variant) As Variant
Dim j As Integer, _
    nExp As Integer
Dim E As Double
Dim t As Date

'calculates for the Limit corresponding exposure
    
    'calculation of exposure:
    E = 0
    'add up all Limits (under consideration of rule for LimitReset) until t0+numBDforExposure (Info that Payment didn't work exists)
    'number of Days for exposure
    nExp = scenario.numDays
    
    If MarketObj.LimitReset = "business day" Then
        'only Limits on Business Day have to be considered
        For j = 1 To nExp
            t = scenario.ListDays(j)
            If ECCCalendar.IsTradingDay(t, MarketObj.Name) <> 0 Then
                E = E + scenario.ECCBDFlags(j) * Limits(j)
            End If
        Next
    Else
        'LimitReset on every calendar day, so every day needs to be considered
        For j = 1 To nExp
            t = scenario.ListDays(j)
            If ECCCalendar.IsTradingDay(t, MarketObj.Name) <> 0 Then
                If j < nExp Or MarketObj.Flag_Auction = 0 Then
                    E = E + Limits(j)
                End If
            End If
        Next
    End If
    
    CalcExposure = E

End Function

VBA MACRO clsCalcForBD.cls 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/clsCalcForBD'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

'Input
Public DCP As clssettingDCP                        'DCP
Public t0 As Date                              't0 business date

'calculations for the market
Public FlagMarketsUsed As Variant               'List of Flags to see what markets have been used
Public colCalcForMarkets As Collection          'collection of all market calculations

'output
Public BaseExposure_MainCur As Double                   'Exposure resulting from minimal absoulte net purchase values

Public Exposure As Double                       'Total Exposure

'Output to excel
Private OutputRows As Integer                   'number of rows for output
Public OutputForExcel As Variant                'Array for output to excel - shows calculation steps
Public OutputLimits As Variant                  'Array for output to excel - shows calculated limits (for each calendar day)
Public OutputLimitsAggregated As Variant        'Array for output to excel - shows calculated limits (successive days with same limits are aggregated)
Public OutputBaseLimits As Variant              'Array for output to excel - shows calculated base limits (for each calendar day)

Sub Initiate(DCPInput As clssettingDCP, InputDate As Date)
Dim j As Integer
Dim calc As clsCalcForMarket
Dim MName As String
Dim t As Date
    
    Set DCP = New clssettingDCP
    'DCP has to be copied
    DCP.Name = DCPInput.Name
    DCP.numMarkets = DCPInput.numMarkets
    DCP.ListMarkets = DCPInput.ListMarkets
    DCP.ListBaseValueBD = DCPInput.ListBaseValueBD
    DCP.ListBaseValueNBD = DCPInput.ListBaseValueNBD
    
    DCP.ListInputValueBD = DCPInput.ListInputValueBD
    DCP.ListInputValueNBD = DCPInput.ListInputValueNBD
    
    'current date
    t0 = InputDate
    
    'Prepare collection of calculations for each market
    Set colCalcForMarkets = New Collection
    'Prepare List of Flag
    ReDim FlagMarketsUsed(1 To DCP.numMarkets)
    'consider market, if next business day after t0 is a trading day
    t = ECCCalendar.DaysWithBDInfo(t0 - ECCCalendar.StartDate + 1, 1)
    For j = 1 To DCP.numMarkets
        MName = DCP.ListMarkets(j)
        FlagMarketsUsed(j) = IIf(ECCCalendar.IsTradingDay(t, MName) <> 0, 1, 0)
    Next
    
    OutputRows = 1
    'for each market one calculation
    For j = 1 To DCP.numMarkets
        'initiate calculation object
        Set calc = New clsCalcForMarket
        Call calc.Initiate(DCP, j, t0)
        
        'add to collection
        'only if trading day
        If FlagMarketsUsed(j) = 1 Then
            MName = DCP.ListMarkets(j)
            colCalcForMarkets.Add calc, MName
            OutputRows = OutputRows + calc.scenario.numDays + 1
        End If
    Next
    
End Sub

Sub CalcStart()
    
    Call CalcBaseLimits
    Call CreateOutputForExcel
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CalcBaseLimits
' Purpose: calculate BaseLimits for each market and add up to BaseExposure, adjust if Collateral is to small
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CalcBaseLimits()
Dim calc As clsCalcForMarket
    
    BaseExposure_MainCur = 0
    
    For Each calc In colCalcForMarkets
    
        'calculate the BaseLimits and BaseExposure
        Call calc.CalcBaseExposure
            
        BaseExposure_MainCur = BaseExposure_MainCur + calc.BaseExposure_MainCur
    
    Next
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateOutputForExcel
' Purpose:
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CreateOutputForExcel()
Dim DCPName As String, _
    MName As String, _
    MCur As String
Dim numcol As Integer, _
    r As Integer, _
    j As Integer, _
    k As Integer
Dim calc As clsCalcForMarket
    
    'number of columns:
    numcol = 11
    '(DCP, bd_0, Market, d_i, Flag BD, BaseValuesDistributed, BaseLimit, BaseExposure, Collateral, CollateralForExcess, ExcessValuesDistributed, ExcessLimit, ExcessExposures, LimitValuesDistributed, Limit, Exposure, MinTestExposure, MaxTestExposure, LimitValuesCur distributed, LimitOutputCur, LimitOutput)
    
    ReDim OutputForExcel(1 To OutputRows, 1 To numcol)
    DCPName = DCP.Name
    'erste Zeile: Gesamtergebnis für DCP, also über alle Märkte
    r = 1
    OutputForExcel(r, 1) = t0
    OutputForExcel(r, 2) = DCPName
    OutputForExcel(r, 11) = BaseExposure_MainCur
    
    For k = 1 To DCP.numMarkets
        If FlagMarketsUsed(k) = 1 Then
            MName = DCP.ListMarkets(k)
            Set calc = colCalcForMarkets(MName)
            MCur = calc.MarketObj.MarketCurrency
            
            For j = 0 To calc.scenario.numDays
                r = r + 1
                OutputForExcel(r, 1) = t0
                OutputForExcel(r, 2) = DCPName
                OutputForExcel(r, 3) = MName
                OutputForExcel(r, 4) = MCur
                OutputForExcel(r, 5) = calc.scenario.ListDays(j)
                OutputForExcel(r, 6) = calc.scenario.BDFlags(j)
                OutputForExcel(r, 7) = calc.scenario.ECCBDFlags(j)
                If j = 0 Then
                    'for t0
                    OutputForExcel(r, 10) = calc.BaseExposure
                    OutputForExcel(r, 11) = calc.BaseExposure_MainCur
                Else
                    'OutputForExcel(r, 7) = calc.InputValuesDistributed(j)
                    OutputForExcel(r, 8) = calc.BaseValuesDistributed(j)
                    OutputForExcel(r, 9) = calc.BaseLimit(j)
                End If
            Next
        End If
    Next
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CalcScenariosForDCP
' Purpose: The method calculates the Limits for all scenarios and writes them into the sheet output
' Caller: a4Start.StartCalc
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter DCP (settingDCP):
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CalcScenariosForDCP(DCP As clssettingDCP)
Dim calcBD As clsCalcForBD
Dim scenario As clsExposureScenario
Dim ColScenariosBD As Collection, _
    colCalc As Collection, _
    colOutput As Collection
Dim indexWorstCase As Integer

    indexWorstCase = 0
    Set colCalc = New Collection
    Set colOutput = New Collection
    For Each ColScenariosBD In colExposureScenarios
        
        Set scenario = ColScenariosBD.item(1)
        
        'start the calculation for DCP and the scenario
        Set calcBD = New clsCalcForBD

        Call calcBD.CalcStart
           
        'put calculation and output to collection
        colCalc.Add calcBD
        Output = calcBD.OutputForExcel
        colOutput.Add Output

    'prepare Output for excel
    Output = TransformCollectionToMatrix(colOutput)
    Sheets("output").Activate
    
    Sheets("output").Unprotect PWD ' ???
    ' writing the output
    Range(Cells(4, 1), Cells(3 + UBound(Output, 1), UBound(Output, 2))).value = Output
    Cells.Select
    Cells.EntireColumn.AutoFit
    Range("A2").Select
    
    Sheets("output").Activate
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateCalendar
' Purpose: The method creates a calendar
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter calName (String): The neame of the calendar, ECC-GBP has a special handling
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CreateCalendar(calName As String)
Dim j As Integer, _
    k As Integer, _
    index As Integer
Dim Data As Variant, _
    BH As Variant, _
    ListECCBD As Variant

    'read Data
    ShtCalendar.Activate
    Cells(Range("Input_StartDataCalendars").Row, 1).Select
    Data = Range(Selection, Selection.End(xlDown)).value
    
    'name
    Name = calName
    
    'start and end
    StartDate = Data(2, 1)
    numBD = UBound(Data, 1) - 1
    EndDate = Data(numBD + 1, 1)
    
    'number of days
    numDays = EndDate - StartDate + 1
    'initialize List
    ReDim Days(1 To numDays)
    ReDim BDFlag(1 To numDays)
    ReDim DaysWithBDInfo(1 To numDays, -1 To 1) ' -1=previous business day, 0 = current day, 1= next business day
    For j = 1 To numDays
        Days(j) = StartDate + j - 1
        BDFlag(j) = 0
        DaysWithBDInfo(j, 0) = Days(j)
    Next
    
    'get Business days
    ReDim ListECCBD(1 To numBD)
    For j = 1 To numBD
        ListECCBD(j) = Data(j + 1, 1)
        index = Data(j + 1, 1) - StartDate + 1
        BDFlag(index) = 1
        If j = 1000 Then
            Debug.Print j
        End If
    Next
    
    'consider bank holidays
    If calName = "ECC-GBP" Then
        BH = Range("BankHolidaysGBP").value
        For j = 1 To UBound(BH, 1)
            If BH(j, 1) >= StartDate And BH(j, 1) <= EndDate Then
                index = BH(j, 1) - StartDate + 1
                If BDFlag(index) = 1 Then
                    BDFlag(index) = 0
                    numBD = numBD - 1
                End If
            End If
        Next
    End If
    
    'adjust List of business days
    ReDim ListBD(1 To numBD)
    index = 1
    For j = 1 To numDays
        If BDFlag(j) = 1 Then
            ListBD(index) = Days(j)
            index = index + 1
        End If
    Next
    
    'get previous and next business day
    index = 0
    k = ListBD(1) - StartDate + 1
    'Data without a previous business day
    For j = 1 To k - 1
        'next business day
        If index + 1 <= numBD Then
            DaysWithBDInfo(j, 1) = ListBD(index + 1)
        End If
    Next
    
    'Data with previous and next business day
    For j = k To numDays
    
        If index > 0 Then
            'previous business day
            DaysWithBDInfo(j, -1) = ListBD(index)
        End If
        
        If BDFlag(j) = 1 Then
            index = index + 1
        End If
        
        'next business day
        If index + 1 <= numBD Then
            DaysWithBDInfo(j, 1) = ListBD(index + 1)
        End If
    Next
    
    'consider bank holidays
    PaymentGBPFlag = BDFlag
    If Range("Flag_BankHolidaysGBP").value = 1 Then
        BH = Range("BankHolidaysGBP").value
        For j = 1 To UBound(BH, 1)
            If BH(j, 1) >= StartDate And BH(j, 1) <= EndDate Then
                index = BH(j, 1) - StartDate + 1
    
                PaymentGBPFlag(index) = 0
            End If
        Next
    End If
    
    'read separate TradingDays
    SeparateTradingDays = Range("SeparateTradingDays").value
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetBDIndex
' Purpose: 'looks in List of business days for date and gives the index of the entry
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter BDDate (Date): the business date
' Return Type: Integer
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetBDIndex(BDDate As Date) As Integer
Dim index As Integer, _
    j As Integer

    index = 0
    For j = 1 To numBD
        If ListBD(j) = BDDate Then
            index = j
            Exit For
        End If
        
        'stop when nothing found
        If ListBD(j) > BDDate Then
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
    
    GetBDIndex = index

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: IsTradingDay
' Purpose: looks in Array of separate trading days if t belongs to trading days for given market
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter t (Date): the day to check if it's a trading day
' Parameter MName (String):
' Return Type: Integer
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function IsTradingDay(t As Date, Optional MName As String) As Integer
Dim j As Integer, _
    k As Integer, _
    Flag As Integer

    Flag = 0
    'trading days available?
    If Not IsEmpty(SeparateTradingDays) Then
        'look for market
        For j = 1 To UBound(SeparateTradingDays, 2)
            If SeparateTradingDays(1, j) = MName Or MName = vbNullString Then
                Flag = 0                                            '<--neue Version|Bugfix (v1.07.3)
                'look for date
                For k = 2 To UBound(SeparateTradingDays, 1)
                    If SeparateTradingDays(k, j) = vbNullString Then
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    If SeparateTradingDays(k, j) = t Then
                        Flag = 1
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    If SeparateTradingDays(k, j) > t Then
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next
                'If Flag = 1 Then                                   '<-- alte Version (v1.07.2)
                If Flag = 1 Or MName <> vbNullString Then                     '<--neue Version|Bugfix (v1.07.3)
                    Exit For
                End If
            Else
                'market not in list of separate calendars
                Flag = -1
            End If
        Next
    End If
    'output
    IsTradingDay = Flag

End Function

Sub Initiate()

    Call GetMarkets
    Call GetInputFromDCPSetting
    
    'other input
    'numBD for Exposure
    numBDForExposure = Range("Input_maxBDForExposure").value  ' The value of markets!D2, this means the maximum value of a value in column D4:D22 * A4:A22 - the column D contains numBDforExposure and column A contains a flag with values 0 or 1
    
    'xrates
    Xrate = Range("Input_XRates").value                       ' The value of cell start!D9
    
End Sub


' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetInputFromDCPSetting
' Purpose: input from DCP-setting
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub GetInputFromDCPSetting()
Dim j As Integer

    DCPName = Range("Input_DCPName").value                ' This is a Clearing member like ABCEX, located in start!D3
    
    Col_Cur = Range("Input_Cur").value                    ' This is the currency of the collateral like EUR or GBP, located in start!D8. possible values are defined in data tools - data validation
    
    DCPPrefNumMarkets = Range("Input_numMarkets").value   ' the number of mentioned markets in cell start!A12. The values is calculated by a formula =ANZAHL2($A$17:$A$23). That means that the makro isn't be able to consider more than 7 markets at the same time
    
If DCPPrefNumMarkets > 0 Then
        DCPPreferences = Range("Input_Preferences").value ' The named range Input_Preferences doesn't exist!!!
    End If
    
    'determine Main Currency
    Main_Cur = EURO                                      ' This is a default
    If Col_Cur = POUND And DCPPrefNumMarkets > 0 Then     ' the value from the sheet and the number of tagged markets
        Main_Cur = POUND                                  ' then assign GBP to the main currency
        For j = 1 To DCPPrefNumMarkets                    ' for each of the tagged markets
            If DCPPreferences(j, 2) <> POUND Then
                Main_Cur = EURO
            End If
        Next
    End If
    
    StartDate = CDate(frmMain.txtDate.text) 'Range("Input_date").value  ' Sheet 'start' C28
    EndDate = CDate(frmMain.txtDate.text) ' Range("Input_EndDate").value ' Sheet 'start' D28
    OutputFrom = StartDate
    OutputUntil = EndDate
    
    Flag_Rounding = 1
    RoundingDigits = -1
    CalcType = 0

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetMarkets
' Purpose: create all markets and put them into collection
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Kathrin Kohoutek
' Date: 14.03.2016
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub GetMarkets()

Dim MarketObj As clsMarket
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim InputMatrix As Variant
    
    'read Data
    InputMatrix = Range("Input_SettingMarkets").value    ' read all markets in the sheet markets into an array
    
    'put it into Collection
    Set colMarkets = New Collection
    
    'Set colMarketsAll = New Collection
    For MarketNb = 1 To UBound(InputMatrix, 1)
        Set MarketObj = New clsMarket
        Call MarketObj.CreateMarket(InputMatrix, MarketNb)
        
        'test, if not empty
        If MarketObj.Name <> vbNullString Then
            colMarkets.Add MarketObj, MarketObj.Name
        End If
    
    Next
    
    ReDim ListAvailableMarkets(1 To colMarkets.Count)
    For MarketNb = 1 To colMarkets.Count
        Set MarketObj = colMarkets.item(MarketNb)
        ListAvailableMarkets(MarketNb) = MarketObj.Name
    Next

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: cboCollCurr_Change
' Purpose: The procedure handels the currencies of collaterals and their exchange rates
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 03.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub cboCollCurr_Change()
Dim IntermediateValue As Double
Dim intIntMedVal As String, _
    CurrencyOrder As String

    With ShtStart
        If Not StartUpProcess Then
            .Range("Input_Cur").value = frmMain.cboCollCurr.value
            .Range("Input_XRatesText").value = frmMain.lblCollateralExchangeRate.Caption
            .Range("Input_XRates").value = frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value
            If frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value <> vbNullString Then
                IntermediateValue = CDbl(1) / CDbl(frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value)
                intIntMedVal = Replace(Format(IntermediateValue, "#,###0.000"), ".", ",")
                intIntMedVal = Replace(intIntMedVal, ",", Fmt.DecSep)
                .Range("Input_XRatesInvers").value = frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value
                .Range("D9").Value2 = CDbl(1) / CDbl(frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value)
                frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value = intIntMedVal
                CurrencyOrder = IIf(.Range("Input_XRatesInvers").value > .Range("Input_XRates").value, "GBP/EUR", "EUR/GBP")
                .Range("Input_XRatesText").value = "Exchange Rate " & CurrencyOrder
                frmMain.lblCollateralExchangeRate.ControlTipText = "This is the exchange rate for calculating from " & Left(CurrencyOrder, 3) & " to " & Right(CurrencyOrder, 3)
                frmMain.txtCollFXRate.ControlTipText = "This is the exchange rate for calculating from " & Left(CurrencyOrder, 3) & " to " & Right(CurrencyOrder, 3)
                frmMain.lblCollateralExchangeRate.Caption = "Exchange Rate " & CurrencyOrder
            End If
        
        Else
            frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value = Replace(ShtStart.Range("Input_XRates").value, ",", Fmt.DecSep)
            frmMain.lblCollateralExchangeRate.Caption = .Range("Input_XRatesText").value
            frmMain.cboCollCurr.value = .Range("Input_Cur").value
        End If
    End With
    DataChangeIndicator
    If Not StartUpProcess Then EnableStartButton
    
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSave_Click()

    ShtStart.Range("Input_date").value = frmMain.txtDate.value
    If InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") > 0 Then frmMain.Caption = Mid(frmMain.Caption, 1, InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") - 2)
    ShtStart.Range("Input_EndDate").value = frmMain.txtDate.value
    StartSub_Calculation
    CollectData
    Call GetAllHolidaysDates(cboCollCurr.value, Year(CDate(frmMain.txtDate.value)))
    
    CompileFinalPDF
    SaveOutput2PDF
        
End Sub

Private Sub cmdStart_Click()
        
    ShtStart.Range("Input_date").value = frmMain.txtDate.value
    
    ' set the Marker back, that something was changed in the user form
    If InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") > 0 Then frmMain.Caption = Mid(frmMain.Caption, 1, InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") - 2)
    
    ' Write the date into the Kathrin's sheet
    ShtStart.Range("Input_EndDate").value = frmMain.txtDate.value
    
    ' Start the button in Kathrin's sheet
    StartSub_Calculation
    
    ' Collect the result data from Kathrin's sheets
    CollectData
    
    ' calculate appropriate holidays
    Call GetAllHolidaysDates(cboCollCurr.value, Year(CDate(frmMain.txtDate.value)))
    
    ' Start calculating and writing data into HTML for showing in the form
    Call CreateHTML
    
    ' Start showing the content of the HTML file in the form
    ShowHTMLResult
    cmdSave.Enabled = True
    cmdO09.Enabled = True
        
End Sub




Private Sub lblFullScreen_Click()

Public Sub txtDate_AfterUpdate()
Dim OutOfScope As String
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim LastYear As Date

    If Not IsDate(txtDate.value) Then
        MsgBox "The value " & txtDate.value & " is not a date, please enter another one!", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    OutOfScope = vbNullString
    cmdDate.Enabled = True
    LastYear = DateAdd("yyyy", 5, Date)
    If Year(CDate(txtDate.value)) < Year(Now()) - 5 Then OutOfScope = "before"
    If Year(CDate(txtDate.value)) > Year(Now()) + 5 Then OutOfScope = "after"
    
    If OutOfScope <> vbNullString Then
        If Not StartUpProcess Then
        OutOfScope = "The selected date " & txtDate.value & " is out scope of this tool!" & vbCrLf & _
                     "The range is from " & CStr(DateAdd("yyyy", -5, CurrentDate)) & " until " & CStr(DateSerial(Year(LastYear), 12, 31))
                     cmdDate.Enabled = False
        MsgBox OutOfScope, vbCritical, "Problem with selected date!"
        Else
            txtDate.value = Date
        End If
    End If
    
    txtDate.ControlTipText = WriteDateInLanguage(txtDate.value)
    ShtLimitCalc.Range("CalculationDate").value = txtDate.value
    ShtStart.Range("Input_date").value = txtDate.value
    ShtStart.Range("Input_EndDate").value = txtDate.value
    Call CheckDate4BusinessDate(txtDate)
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        If Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value <> vbNullString Then
            Call CheckForValidSpecialMarkets(MarketNb)
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    DataChangeIndicator
    EnableStartButton
    
End Sub

    EnableStartButton

        frmMain.txtResFinRisk.BackColor = vbYellow
        frmMain.txtOpenFinRisk.BackColor = vbYellow

Sub dayClick(DayNb As Integer)
Dim MarketNb As Integer

    dateControl.text = Me.Controls("day" & CStr(DayNb)).Tag
    If AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(CDate(dateControl.text)) Then txtDate.BackColor = vbWhite Else txtDate.BackColor = vbRed
        For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        If Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value <> vbNullString Then
            Call CheckForValidSpecialMarkets(MarketNb)
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    fraDatePicker.Visible = False
    
End Sub

Private Sub chkfullscreen_Click()

    If Me.chkFullScreen.value = True Then
        startTop = Me.Top
        startLeft = Me.Left
        Me.Top = 0
        Me.Left = 0
        Me.Height = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN)
        Me.Width = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN)
        
        Select Case Me.Height
            Case 864
                Call SetResultSize(400, 1120)
            Case 1080
                Call SetResultSize(290, 910)
            Case 1296
                Call SetResultSize(400, 1120)
            Case 1440
                Call SetResultSize(830, 1880)
            Case 1536
                Call SetResultSize(520, 930)
            Case 1620
                Call SetResultSize(570, 1410)
            Case 2160
                Call SetResultSize(840, 1880)
        End Select
        
    Else
        Me.Top = startTop
        Me.Left = startLeft
        Me.Height = MAINFORM_HEIGHT
        Me.Width = MAINFORM_WIDTH
        
        Call SetResultSize(MAINFORM_FRARESULT_HEIGHT, MAINFORM_FRARESULT_WIDTH)
        
    End If
    
End Sub


' ================================================================================================================
' from here comes the date picker code


'creates the caledar for the month / year
Sub buildCalendar(Optional iYear As Integer, Optional iMonth As Integer)
Dim startOfMonth As Date, _
    trackingDate As Date
Dim iStartofMonthDay As Integer, _
    i As Integer
Dim cDay As Control
        
    'if the year or month isn't passed in, then assume current year and month
    If iYear = 0 Or iMonth = 0 Then
        iYear = VBA.Year(Now())
        iMonth = VBA.Month(Now())
    End If
    
    'set the month and year in the calendar
    Me.Controls("lblmonth").Caption = VBA.MonthName(iMonth, True)
    Me.Controls("lblyear").Caption = iYear
    
    'calcuate the start of the month and the start of the calendar (top left day)
    startOfMonth = VBA.DateSerial(iYear, iMonth, 1)
    CurrentDate = startOfMonth
    iStartofMonthDay = VBA.Weekday(startOfMonth, vbSunday)
    trackingDate = DateAdd("d", -iStartofMonthDay + 1, startOfMonth)
    
    'loop through all the day controls
    For i = 1 To 42
        
        'get and set the day controls
        Set cDay = frmMain.Controls("day" & i)
        cDay.Caption = VBA.Day(trackingDate)
        cDay.Tag = trackingDate
        
        'make the days not in the current month gray
        If VBA.Month(trackingDate) <> iMonth Then
            cDay.ForeColor = 8421504
        Else
            cDay.ForeColor = 0
        End If
        If Not AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(trackingDate) Then cDay.Visible = False Else cDay.Visible = True
        
        If CurrentCalendar = "T2" Then btnToday.Enabled = AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(Date)
        If CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then btnToday.Enabled = Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(Date)
        
        
        With HolidayDateDict.item(iYear)
            If .NewYearsDay = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .GoodFriday = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .EasterMonday = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .labourDay = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .EarlyMayBankHoliday = trackingDate And CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .SpringBankHoliday = trackingDate And CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .SummerBankHoliday = trackingDate And CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .ChristmasDay = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .BoxingDay = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .SubstituteDay1 = trackingDate And CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .SubstituteDay2 = trackingDate And CurrentCalendar = "GB" Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .CustHoliday1 = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .CustHoliday2 = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .CustHoliday3 = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .CustHoliday4 = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
            If .CustHoliday5 = trackingDate Then cDay.Visible = False
        End With
        
        'move to the next day
        trackingDate = VBA.DateAdd("d", 1, trackingDate)
    
    Next i
    
End Sub

'shows / hides date picker
Public Sub tglDatePicker(oControl As Control)

    With frmMain.fraDatePicker
        
        If .Visible Then                                   'check if its visible
            .Visible = False                               'already there, so toggle it off
        Else
            If VBA.IsDate(oControl.text) Then              'check if there is already a date in the text box
                buildCalendar VBA.Year(oControl.text), _
                              VBA.Month(oControl.text)     'load the calendar with that date
            Else
                buildCalendar                              'no date
            End If
            
            Set dateControl = oControl                     'set the global control so when the calendar gets clicked, we know what textbox to update
            .Top = dateControl.Top                         'set the position of the calendar
            .Visible = True                                'show the calendar
            
        End If
    End With
        
End Sub


Private Sub SetResultSize(FH As Integer, FW As Integer)
        Me.fraResult.Height = FH
        Me.fraResult.Width = FW
        Me.WebBrowser1.Height = FH - 20
        Me.WebBrowser1.Width = FW - 10
End Sub

VBA MACRO frmConfig.frm 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/frmConfig'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit

Enum enuHolidays
        enuNewYearsDay = "01"         ' T2 + GB - New Year's Day (Neujahr)
        enuGoodFriday = "02"          ' T2 + GB - Good Friday (Karfreitag)
        enuEasterMonday = "03"        ' T2 + GB - Easter Monday (Ostermontag)
        enuLabourDay = "04"           ' T2 + GB - Labour Day
        enuEarlyMayBankHoliday = "05" '      GB - Early May bank holiday
        enuSpringBankHoliday = "06"   '      GB - Spring bank holiday
        enuSummerBankHoliday = "07"   '      GB - Summer bank holiday
        enuChristmasDay = "08"        ' T2 + GB - Christmas Day
        enuBoxingDay = "09"           ' T2 + GB - Boxing Day
        enuSubstitute1Day = "10"      '      GB - Substitue day 1, if in GB Boxing day is a Saturday then the following Monday becomes a holiday
        enuSubstitute2Day = "11"      '      GB - Substitue day 2, if in GB Christmas day is a Saturday  and Boxing day is Sunday then the following Monday and the Tuesday become a holiday
        
        enuCustomizedDay1 = "12"      '         - Customized Holiday 1
        enuCustomizedDay2 = "13"      '         - Customized Holiday 2
        enuCustomizedDay3 = "14"      '         - Customized Holiday 3
        enuCustomizedDay4 = "15"      '         - Customized Holiday 4
        enuCustomizedDay5 = "16"      '         - Customized Holiday 5
End Enum

Private Sub cmdCEOK_Click()
Dim State As String, _
    ColumnAddress As String, _
    strHDNb As String
Dim HDNb As Integer

    With frmConfig
        State = Mid(.cboCEFederalState.value, 1, 2)
        For HDNb = 1 To MAXHOLIDAYS
            strHDNb = Format(HDNb, "00")
            ColumnAddress = FederalStateDict.item(State).Address & Format(HDNb + 3, "00")
            
            ShtHolidays.Range(ColumnAddress).value = IIf(.Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value, "x", vbNullString)
            ShtHolidays.Range(ColumnAddress).value = IIf(.Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value, "x", vbNullString)
            ShtHolidays.Range("B" & CStr(HDNb + 3)).value = IIf(.Controls("txtEnglish" & strHDNb).value <> vbNullString, .Controls("txtEnglish" & strHDNb).value, INITDATE)
            ShtHolidays.Range("C" & CStr(HDNb + 3)).value = IIf(.Controls("txtGerman" & strHDNb).value <> vbNullString, .Controls("txtGerman" & strHDNb).value, INITDATE)
            ShtHolidays.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb + 3)).value = IIf(.Controls("txtHowToCalc" & strHDNb).value <> vbNullString, .Controls("txtHowToCalc" & strHDNb).value, vbNullString)
        
        Next HDNb
        
        For HDNb = MAXSTDHDAY To MAXHOLIDAYS
            strHDNb = CStr(HDNb)
            .Controls("lblCE" & strHDNb).Caption = .Controls("txtEnglish" & strHDNb).value
            .Controls("txtCE" & strHDNb).value = .Controls("txtHowToCalc" & strHDNb).value
        Next HDNb
        
        
        GetHolidaysInfos
        PutHolidayInfosIntoForm
        
        If Mid(.cboCEFederalState.value, 1, 2) = "GB" Then
            Call PutGBHolidaysIntoRange(cboCEYear.value)
        End If
        
        If Mid(.cboCEFederalState.value, 1, 2) = "T2" Then
            Call RecreateECCCalendar
        End If
        
        ShtHolidays.Range("CalendarCurrency").value = .cboCECurrency.value
        ShtHolidays.Range("CalendarYear").value = .cboCEYear.value
    End With
    
    With frmMain
        Call GetAllHolidaysDates(.cboCollCurr.value, Year(CDate(.txtDate.value)))
        .buildCalendar
    End With
    Unload Me
        
End Sub

Private Sub txtConfMarket_AfterUpdate()
Dim MsgBoxAnswer As String

    txtConfMarket.value = UCase(txtConfMarket.value)
    
    If frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value <> vbNullString Then
        cmdConfMarketsOK.Enabled = True
        cmdConfMarketsDelete.Enabled = True
    End If
    
    Select Case Right(txtConfMarket.value, 3)
        Case EURO
            cboConfCurrency.value = EURO
            cboConfBDCalendar.value = ECC
        Case POUND
            cboConfCurrency.value = POUND
            cboConfBDCalendar.value = ECCPOUND
        Case Else
            txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbYellow
            MsgBoxAnswer = MsgBox("The name of the market does not comply with the rules for the formation of market names," & vbCrLf & _
                              "it should contain the respective currency at the end, separated by an underline." & vbCrLf & _
                              "Would you like to correct that?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "Data inconsistencies detected!")
        Select Case MsgBoxAnswer
            
            Case vbYes
                txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbWhite
                txtConfMarket.value = vbNullString
            Case vbNo
                txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbWhite
        End Select
    End Select
    
End Sub

Private Sub cmdConfMarketsCancel_Click()
Dim MarketNb As Integer
    With frmMain
        For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
            If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value <> vbNullString Then
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Picture = .btnBasketActive.Picture
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Locked = False
            Else
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Locked = True
            End If
        Next MarketNb
    End With
    
    Unload Me
    
End Sub

Private Sub cmdConfMarketsDelete_Click()
Dim strLine As String, _
    amn As String
Dim MarketNb As Byte, _
    AffectedMarketNb As Byte
Dim SpecCol As Integer
Dim Msg, Style, Title, Response

    If frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value = vbNullString Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If SpecMarketColumnsDict.Exists(frmConfig.txtConfMarket.text) Then
        SpecCol = SpecMarketColumnsDict.item(frmConfig.txtConfMarket.text)
        If ShtCalendar.Cells(4, SpecCol).value <> vbNullString Then
            Msg = "Be careful! For this market we have special trading dates in the calendar!" & vbCrLf & _
            "Do you want to delete them too?"
                        
            Style = vbYesNo
            Title = "Delete a market with existing trading dates"    ' Define title.
            Response = MsgBox(Msg, Style, Title)
            If Response = vbYes Then    ' User chose Yes.
                ShtCalendar.Columns(SpecCol).EntireColumn.Delete
                Call SetSpecMarketsPosition
            Else    ' User chose No.
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If
    End If
    AffectedMarketNb = 0
    
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        If frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value = frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value Then
            AffectedMarketNb = MarketNb
            If MsgBox("The market " & frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value & " is still used in the " & NumbersSuffix(AffectedMarketNb) & " position," & vbCrLf & _
            "do you want to delete this market and the market in the market main form anyway?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "Delete " & frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value) = vbNo Then
                Exit Sub
            End If  ' Result of message box (yes/no)
        End If      ' to delete Market found in the list of used markets
    Next MarketNb
    
    ' Delete the information in the user form
    With frmConfig
        .txtConfMarket.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfLimitReset.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfBDforExposure.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfAuctionFlag.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfCurrency.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfBDCalendar.value = vbNullString
        .cboConfSepTDCalendar.value = vbNullString
    End With
    
    ' Delete the information in the list form
    MarketsSheetLineNb = GetMarketsFromList(MarketCorrection)
    With ShtMarkets
        .Range("A" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("B" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("C" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("D" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("E" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("F" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("G" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
        .Range("H" & MarketsSheetLineNb).value = vbNullString
    End With
    
    strLine = CStr(MarketsSheetLineNb)
   
    Range("A4:H22").Sort Key1:=Range("B4"), _
                     Order1:=xlAscending, _
                     Key2:=Range("C4"), _
                     Order1:=xlAscending, _
                     Header:=xlYes
   
    ' Remove the market from the Main form list
    If AffectedMarketNb > 0 Then
        amn = CStr(AffectedMarketNb)
        With frmMain
            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & amn).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & amn).BackColor = vbWhite
            
            .Controls("btnBasket_0" & amn).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
            .Controls("btnBasket_0" & amn).Locked = True
            
            .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & amn).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & amn).BackColor = vbWhite
            
            .Controls("txtBDA_0" & amn).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("txtBDA_0" & amn).BackColor = vbWhite
            
            .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & amn).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & amn).BackColor = vbWhite
            
            .Controls("txtDist_0" & amn).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("txtDist_0" & amn).BackColor = vbWhite
        End With
    End If
    
    ' Write the currency of each market into a dictionary
    GetMarketsCurrency
    Call FillListbox(ShtMarkets, "A4:H")
    Call FillMarketsIntoComboboxes(False)
    
End Sub
