' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: cmdConfMarketsOK_Click
' Purpose: The sub checks plausibility of entered data and writes them into the appropriate sheet "markets"
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Author: xc165
' Date: 07.03.2025
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub cmdConfMarketsOK_Click()
Dim strLine As String, _
    MsgBoxAnswer As String
Dim LastColumn As Long
    
Start:
    strLine = CStr(MarketsSheetLineNb)
    MarketCorrection = True
    
    ' check column "LimitReset on each ?" for valid values
    If cboConfLimitReset.value <> "day" And cboConfLimitReset.value <> "business day" And cboConfLimitReset.value <> "Day" Then
        cboConfLimitReset.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "Invalid value for Limit Reset on each ?" & vbCrLf & "allowed are only 'day' and 'business day'", vbCritical
        cboConfLimitReset.BackColor = vbWhite
        cboConfLimitReset.value = vbNullString
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' check column "numBDforExposure to + ? on each ?" for valid values
    If cboConfBDforExposure.value <> "2" And cboConfBDforExposure.value <> "3" Then
        cboConfBDforExposure.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "Invalid value for number BD for Exposure" & vbCrLf & "allowed are only '2' and '3'", vbCritical
        cboConfBDforExposure.BackColor = vbWhite
        cboConfBDforExposure.value = vbNullString
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' check column "currency" for valid values
    If cboConfCurrency.value <> EURO And cboConfCurrency.value <> POUND Then
        cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "Invalid value for currency" & vbCrLf & "allowed are only 'EUR' and 'GBP'", vbCritical
        cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbWhite
        cboConfCurrency.value = vbNullString
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' check column "BD calendar" for valid values
    If cboConfBDCalendar.value <> ECC And cboConfBDCalendar.value <> ECCPOUND Then
        cboConfBDCalendar.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "Invalid value for BD calendar" & vbCrLf & "allowed are only 'ECC' and 'ECC-GBP'", vbCritical
        cboConfBDCalendar.BackColor = vbWhite
        cboConfBDCalendar.value = vbNullString
        Exit Sub
    End If
  
    ' check if the market's currency definition in the market name matches with the selected currency of the market
    If InStr(txtConfMarket.value, cboConfCurrency.value) = 0 Then
        txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbYellow
        cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbYellow
        MsgBoxAnswer = MsgBox("The name of the market does not comply with the rules for the formation of market names," & vbCrLf & _
                              "it should contain the respective currency at the end, separated by an underline." & vbCrLf & _
                              "Would you like to correct that?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "Data inconsistencies detected!")
        Select Case MsgBoxAnswer
            
            Case vbYes
                txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbWhite
                cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbWhite
                txtConfMarket.value = vbNullString
                cboConfCurrency.value = vbNullString
                GoTo InconsistenceHandling
            Case vbNo
                txtConfMarket.BackColor = vbWhite
                cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbWhite
                    
        End Select
    End If
    
    If (cboConfCurrency.value = EURO And cboConfBDCalendar.value <> ECC) Or _
       (cboConfCurrency.value = POUND And cboConfBDCalendar.value <> ECCPOUND) Then
        cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbYellow
        cboConfBDCalendar.BackColor = vbYellow
        MsgBoxAnswer = MsgBox("The set currency does not match the selected calendar." & vbCrLf & _
                              "If the EUR currency is used, the ECC calendar should be selected" & vbCrLf & _
                              "and if the GBP currency is used, the ECC-GBP calendar should be selected." & vbCrLf & _
                              "Would you like to correct that?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "Data inconsistencies detected!")
                              
        Select Case MsgBoxAnswer
            
            Case vbYes
                cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbWhite
                cboConfBDCalendar.BackColor = vbWhite
                cboConfCurrency.value = vbNullString
                cboConfBDCalendar.value = vbNullString
                GoTo InconsistenceHandling
            Case vbNo
                cboConfCurrency.BackColor = vbWhite
                cboConfBDCalendar.BackColor = vbWhite
                    
        End Select
    End If
    
    With ShtMarkets
        .Range("B" & strLine).value = frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value
        .Range("C" & strLine).value = cboConfLimitReset.value
        .Range("D" & strLine).value = cboConfBDforExposure.value
        .Range("E" & strLine).value = IIf(blnConfAuctionFlag, 1, 0)
        .Range("F" & strLine).value = cboConfCurrency.value
        .Range("G" & strLine).value = cboConfBDCalendar.value
        .Range("H" & strLine).value = IIf(blnConfSepTDCalendar, 1, 0)
    End With
    MarketCorrection = False
    
    If blnConfSepTDCalendar Then
        If Not SpecialMarketDict.Exists(frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value) Then
            LastColumn = ShtCalendar.Cells(3, ShtCalendar.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
            ShtCalendar.Cells(3, LastColumn + 1) = frmConfig.txtConfMarket.value
            Columns(ColumnAddress(LastColumn + 1)).AutoFit
        End If
    End If
    
    ' Write the currency of each market into a dictionary
    GetMarketsCurrency
    Call FillMarketsIntoComboboxes(False)
    EnableStartButton
    Call FillListbox(ShtMarkets, "A4:H")
    
    ' New since 06.03.2025: Without Exit sub, we would have an endless loop here
    Exit Sub
    
InconsistenceHandling:
    GoTo Start
 
End Sub

Private Sub lstAux_Click()
    
    If lstAux.ListIndex > -1 And lstAux.Selected(lstAux.ListIndex) Then
        txtConfWeekDay.value = lstAux.List(lstAux.ListIndex, 0)
        txtConfBaseExposure.value = lstAux.List(lstAux.ListIndex, 1)
        txtConfLimitRest.value = lstAux.List(lstAux.ListIndex, 2)
        txtConfBLAI.value = lstAux.List(lstAux.ListIndex, 3)
        txtConfBLAA.value = lstAux.List(lstAux.ListIndex, 4)
        If txtConfWeekDay.value = "Thursday" Or _
           txtConfWeekDay.value = "Friday" Then
            txtConfBaseExposure.ControlTipText = "(2 * Base limit BD Intraday) + (2 * Base limit NBD Intraday)  + (3 * Base limit Auction)"
        Else
            txtConfBaseExposure.ControlTipText = "(2 * Base Limit BD Intraday) + Base Limit Auction"
        End If
        If txtConfWeekDay.value = "Friday" Then
            txtConfBLAI.ControlTipText = "Base limit BD intraday + (2 * Base limit NBD Intraday )"
        Else
            txtConfBLAI.ControlTipText = "Base limit BD Intraday"
        End If
        txtConfBLAA.ControlTipText = "Base limit Auction"
    
    End If
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: tglDatePicker
' Purpose: shows / hides date picker
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Parameter oControl (Control): specifies the control, to which the date picker has to be related
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 21.01.2025
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub tglDatePicker(oControl As Control)

    'check if its visible
    If fraConfigDatePicker.Visible Then
        
        'already there, so toggle it off
        fraConfigDatePicker.Visible = False
        
    Else
        
        'check if there is already a date in the text box
        If VBA.IsDate(oControl.text) Then
        
            'load the calendar with that date
            buildCalendar VBA.Year(oControl.text), VBA.Month(oControl.text)
            
        Else
            
            'no date
            buildCalendar
            
        End If
        
        'set the global control so when the calendar gets clicked
        'we know what textbox to update
        Set dateControl = oControl
        
        'set the position of the calendar
        fraConfigDatePicker.Top = dateControl.Top
        
        'show the calendar
        fraConfigDatePicker.Visible = True
        
    End If

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: buildCalendar
' Purpose: This creates the caledar for the month / year
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter iYear (Integer): The specified year
' Parameter iMonth (Integer): The specified month
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 21.01.2025
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub buildCalendar(Optional iYear As Integer, Optional iMonth As Integer)
Dim startOfMonth As Date, _
    trackingDate As Date
Dim iStartofMonthDay As Integer, _
    i As Integer
Dim cDay As Control
    
    'if the year or month isn't passed in, then assume current year and month
    If iYear = 0 Or iMonth = 0 Then
        iYear = VBA.Year(Now())
        iMonth = VBA.Month(Now())
    End If
    
    'set the month and year in the calendar
    Me.Controls("lblmonth").Caption = VBA.MonthName(iMonth, True)
    Me.Controls("lblyear").Caption = iYear
    
    'calcuate the start of the month and the start of the calendar (top left day)
    startOfMonth = VBA.DateSerial(iYear, iMonth, 1)
    CurrentDate = startOfMonth
    iStartofMonthDay = VBA.Weekday(startOfMonth, vbSunday)
    trackingDate = DateAdd("d", -iStartofMonthDay + 1, startOfMonth)
    
    'loop through all the day controls
    For i = 1 To 42
        
        'get and set the day controls
        Set cDay = Me.Controls("day" & i)
        cDay.Caption = VBA.Day(trackingDate)
        cDay.Tag = trackingDate
        
        'make the days not in the current month gray
        cDay.ForeColor = IIf(VBA.Month(trackingDate) <> iMonth, 8421504, 1)
        
        If Weekday(trackingDate) = vbSaturday Or Weekday(trackingDate) = vbSunday Then
            cDay.Visible = False
        End If
        
        'move to the next day
        trackingDate = VBA.DateAdd("d", 1, trackingDate)
    
    Next i

End Sub

Sub SetControlTipText(IsNewText As Boolean)
Dim Prefix As String
    
    Prefix = IIf(IsNewText, NEWCONTENT, OLDCONTENT)
    With frmConfig
        .txtConfMarket.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfMarket.Caption: .lblConfMarket.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfMarket.Caption
        .cboConfLimitReset.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfLimitReset.Caption: .lblConfLimitReset.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfLimitReset.Caption
        .cboConfAuctionFlag.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfAuctionFlag.Caption: .lblConfAuctionFlag.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfAuctionFlag.Caption
        .cboConfBDCalendar.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfBDCalendar.Caption: .lblConfBDCalendar.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfBDCalendar.Caption
        .cboConfBDforExposure.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfBDforExposure.Caption: .lblConfBDforExposure.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfBDforExposure.Caption
        .cboConfCurrency.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfCurrency.Caption: .lblConfCurrency.ControlTipText = Prefix & .lblConfCurrency.Caption

    End With

End Sub

Public Sub InitializeApp()
Dim StdCalendar As String
Dim tmpStates
Dim StateNb As Integer
Dim States As clsStates
        
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
    
    Set Fmt = New clsCalendar
    Fmt.LocalFormat = GetSysShortDate
    Fmt.DecSep = Application.International(xlDecimalSeparator)
    Fmt.ExcelCountryCode = Application.International(xlCountryCode)
    Fmt.WindowsLangCode = Application.International(xlCountrySetting)
    Fmt.MSOLangCode = Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDUI)
        
    Set ShtStart = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTSTART_NAME)
    Set ShtCalendar = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTCALENDAR_NAME)
    Set ShtHolidays = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTHOLIDAYS_NAME)
    Set ShtOutput = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTOUTPUT_NAME)
    Set ShtTplPDF = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ShtTPLPDF_NAME)

    Set ShtAuxiliar = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTAUXILIAR_NAME)
    Set ShtLimitCalc = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTLIMITCALC_NAME)
    Set ShtPDF = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTPDF_NAME)
    Set ShtBck = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTBACKUP_NAME)
    Set ShtLNG = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTLNG_NAME)
    
    If ShtStart.Range("Input_XRates") = vbNullString Then
        ShtStart.Range("Input_XRates") = IIf(Fmt.DecSep = ",", "0,941", "0.941")
    End If
    
    CurrPath = Application.ActiveWorkbook.Path & "\"
    
    LocalSeparator = Excel.Application.International(XlApplicationInternational.xlDateSeparator)
    
    StartUpProcess = True
    ReadAllECCBusinessdays
    Call MarketConfCbos
    
    frmConfig.cboCEYear.value = Year(Now)
    
    TotalDistPercent = 0
    
    ' Get the language id - based on table in
    ' https://learn.microsoft.com/de-de/deployoffice/office2016/language/language-identifiers-optionstate-id-values
    LCID = Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDUI)
    CTDE = False ' IIf(LCID = 1031, True, False)
    ' 1033 is english american
                          
    FillLngDict
    
    Fmt.MSOLangName = LngDict.item(Fmt.MSOLangCode)
    
    tmpStates = Range("CalendarStates")
    ReDim FederalStates(UBound(tmpStates) - 1)
    For StateNb = 0 To UBound(tmpStates) - 1
        FederalStates(StateNb) = tmpStates(StateNb + 1, 1) & " - " & tmpStates(StateNb + 1, 2)
    Next StateNb
                          
    Set States = New clsStates
    FederalStateDict.RemoveAll
    
    For StateNb = 1 To UBound(tmpStates)
        
        States.Abbreviation = tmpStates(StateNb, 1)
        States.Name_GB = tmpStates(StateNb, 2)
        States.Name_DE = tmpStates(StateNb, 3)
        States.Address = tmpStates(StateNb, 4)
        States.cboText = tmpStates(StateNb, 1) & " - " & tmpStates(StateNb, 2)
        
        FederalStateDict.Add States.Abbreviation, States
        
        Set States = New clsStates
    Next StateNb
    
    With ShtHolidays
        HCOL_T2 = .Range("M4").value
        HCOL_GB = .Range("M5").value
        HCOL_CU = .Range("M6").value
    End With
    
    Set Vers = New clsVersion
    VersionsDict.RemoveAll
    With Vers
        .ReleaseVersion = ShtStart.Range("B37").value
        .ReleaseDate = ShtStart.Range("C37").value
        .Ticket = ShtStart.Range("D37").value
        .Commit_ID = ShtStart.Range("E37").value
    End With
    VersionsDict.Add "Local", Vers
        
    Set States = Nothing
        
    StdCalendar = ShtHolidays.Range("SelectedCalendar")
    frmMain.lblCalendar.Caption = StdCalendar
    
    frmConfig.cboCEFederalState.AddItem StdCalendar
    
    arrSpecialMarkets = GetSpecMarkets
    
    SetSpecMarketsPosition
    
    RetrieveCurrencies
    
    GetHolidaysInfos
    
    CopySheetValuesIntoForm
        
    If InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") > 0 Then frmMain.Caption = Mid(frmMain.Caption, 1, InStr(frmMain.Caption, "*") - 2)

End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CopyFormValuesIntoSheet
' Purpose: The procedure copies values from the user form into thge start-sheet.
'          This is used after deleting a market  for referesh the values for markets, BDA, NBDA and Dist
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: xc165
' Date: 07.03.2025

Public Sub CopyFormValuesIntoSheet()
Dim MNb As Integer

    With frmMain
        For MNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
            ShtStart.Range("Market_0" & CStr(MNb)).value = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MNb)).value
            ShtStart.Range("Currency_0" & CStr(MNb)).value = .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(MNb)).value
            ShtStart.Range("BDA_0" & CStr(MNb)).value = .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MNb)).value
            ShtStart.Range("NBDA_0" & CStr(MNb)).value = .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MNb)).value
            ShtLimitCalc.Range("Dist_0" & CStr(MNb)).value = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MNb)).value
        Next MNb
    End With

End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CopySheetValuesIntoForm
' Purpose: The procedure fills the values from the sheet and writes them into the form controls
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: ingmar.pfeiffer
' Date: 19.04.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub CopySheetValuesIntoForm()
Dim MissingCurrency As String, _
    tmpDate1 As String
Dim PrfNb As Integer

    Call FillMarketsIntoComboboxes(True)

    StartCheckInfos = False
    With frmMain
        ' 5 Letter code for DCP xxxEX
        .txtDCP.text = ShtStart.Range("Input_DCPName")
        .txtDCP.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""Input_DCPName"""
        
        ' Trading date for evaluation
        tmpDate1 = WriteLocalDate(ShtLimitCalc.Range("CalculationDate").value)
        .txtDate.text = vbNullString
        .txtDate.text = tmpDate1
        Call .txtDate_AfterUpdate
        ' .txtDate.ControlTipText = WriteDateInLanguage(tmpDate1)
        
        ' Currency from combobox
        .cboCollCurr.text = ShtStart.Range("Input_Cur")
        .cboCollCurr.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""input_Cur"""
        
        ' Available collaterals
        .txtCollateral.text = ShtLimitCalc.Range("Collateral")
        .txtCollateral.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""Collateral"""
        
        ' Text for exchange rate
        .lblCollateralExchangeRate.Caption = ShtStart.Range("Input_XRatesText")
        
        ' Value of FX rate
        .txtCollFXRate.text = Replace(Format(ShtStart.Range("Input_XRates"), "#,###0.000"), ".", ",")
        .txtCollFXRate.text = Replace(.txtCollFXRate.text, ",", Fmt.DecSep)
        .txtCollFXRate.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""Input_XRates"""
        
        ' Value of open financial risk
        .txtOpenFinRisk.text = ShtLimitCalc.Range("OpenFinancialRisk")
        .txtOpenFinRisk.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""OpenFinancialRisk"""
        
        ' value of resolved financial risk
        .txtResFinRisk.text = ShtLimitCalc.Range("ResolvedFinancialRisk")
        .txtResFinRisk.ControlTipText = "Get data from named range ""ResolvedFinancialRisk"""
        
        For PrfNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
    
            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value = vbNullString
            .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = vbNullString
            .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = vbNullString
            If ShtStart.Range("Market_0" & CStr(PrfNb)) <> vbNullString Then
                ' Paper bin ...
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).Picture = .btnBasketActive.Picture
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).Locked = False
                
                ' Market
                .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value = ShtStart.Range("Market_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value
                MissingCurrency = MarketCcyDict.item(ShtStart.Range("Market_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value)
                ' Currency
                If ShtStart.Range("Currency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text <> vbNullString Then
                    .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value = ShtStart.Range("Currency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value
                Else
                    ShtStart.Range("Currency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = MissingCurrency
                    .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value = MissingCurrency
                End If
                
                ' BDA and NBDA
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = ShtStart.Range("BDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = ShtStart.Range("NBDA_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value
                
                ' Distribution perc.
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).text = ShtLimitCalc.Range("Dist_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).value
                
            Else
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(PrfNb)).Locked = True
            End If
        Next PrfNb
        
    End With
    StartCheckInfos = True
    EnableStartButton

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: IsTheDateValid
' Purpose: The function checks if the date from the parameter is in business calendar in sheet calendar or not
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter TheDate (String): the date to check
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 19.04.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function IsTheDateValid(theDate As String) As Boolean
Dim LastRow As Long, _
    intdate As Long
    
    IsTheDateValid = False
    intdate = Int(CDbl(CDate(theDate)))
    LastRow = LastRowOfColumn(ShtCalendar, 1)
    If Not IsError(Application.Match(intdate, ShtCalendar.Range("A2:A" & CStr(LastRow)), 0)) Then
        IsTheDateValid = True
    End If

End Function

Public Sub ReadAllECCBusinessdays()
Dim LastRow As Long
Dim arrBusinessDays, _
    BDay As Variant
   
    LastRow = LastRowOfColumn(ShtCalendar, 1)
    arrBusinessDays = ShtCalendar.Range("A2:A" & CStr(LastRow))
    AllBusinessDaysDict.RemoveAll
    For Each BDay In arrBusinessDays
        If Not AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(BDay) Then
            AllBusinessDaysDict.Add CDate(BDay), CDate(BDay)
        End If
    Next BDay

End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: FillMarketsIntoListbox
' Purpose: The sub fills the listbox in the configuration section with values from the sheet markets
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 23.04.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub FillListbox(SheetToFill As Worksheet, TableAdress As String)
Dim Rng As Range
Dim LastLine As Long, _
    LB As Integer, _
    ColNb As Integer
Dim theDate As Variant, _
    PK As String, _
    CollAddr As String
    
    Set Rng = Nothing
    
    If IsNumeric(TableAdress) Then
        CollAddr = ColumnAddress(CInt(TableAdress))
        TableAdress = CollAddr & "4:" & CollAddr
    End If
    
    LastLine = SheetToFill.Range(Mid(TableAdress, 1, 1) & SheetToFill.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    Set Rng = SheetToFill.Range(TableAdress & CStr(LastLine))
    
    Select Case SheetToFill.Name
        Case SHTMARKETS_NAME
                ' MarketSort
                    With frmConfig.lstMarkets
                        ' .Clear
                        .ColumnHeads = True
                        .ColumnCount = Rng.Columns.Count
                    
                        .RowSource = "=" & SheetToFill.Name & "!" & TableAdress & LastLine ' Rw' rng 'SheetToFill.Range(TableAdress & LastLine + 1).Address
                    
                        .TopIndex = 0
                    End With
                
        Case SHTAUXILIAR_NAME
        
                With frmConfig.lstAux
                    ' .Clear
                    .ColumnHeads = True
                    .ColumnCount = Rng.Columns.Count
                
                
                    .RowSource = "=" & SheetToFill.Name & "!" & TableAdress & LastLine ' Rw' rng 'SheetToFill.Range(TableAdress & LastLine + 1).Address
                    
                    .TopIndex = 0
                End With
        Case SHTCALENDAR_NAME
        
                Select Case Mid(TableAdress, 1, 1)
                    Case "G"
                        SpecialMarketDict.RemoveAll
                        LB = 1
                        Set colSpecialMarket01 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket01.Add theDate.value
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                        
                    Case "H":
                        LB = 2
                        Set colSpecialMarket02 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket02.Add theDate
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                    Case "I":
                        LB = 3
                        Set colSpecialMarket03 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket03.Add theDate
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                    Case "J":
                        LB = 4
                        Set colSpecialMarket04 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket04.Add theDate
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                    
                    Case "K":
                        LB = 5
                        Set colSpecialMarket05 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket05.Add theDate
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                        
                    Case Else
                        LB = 6
                        Set colSpecialMarket06 = New Collection
                        For Each theDate In Rng
                            If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                                colSpecialMarket06.Add theDate
                            End If
                        Next theDate
                    
                End Select
                
                For Each theDate In Rng
                    If theDate <> vbNullString Then
                        PK = CStr(LB) & "_" & theDate.value
                        If Not SpecialMarketDict.Exists(PK) Then
                            SpecialMarketDict.Add PK, theDate.value
                        End If
                    End If
                Next theDate
                
                With frmConfig.Controls("lstSpecMarket0" & CStr(LB))
                    .RowSource = vbNullString
                    .ColumnHeads = False
                    .ColumnCount = Rng.Columns.Count
                
                
                    .RowSource = "=" & SheetToFill.Name & "!" & TableAdress & LastLine ' Rw' rng 'SheetToFill.Range(TableAdress & LastLine + 1).Address
                
                    .TopIndex = 0
                End With
        
                With frmConfig.lstSpecMarket06
                    .RowSource = vbNullString
                    .ColumnHeads = False
                    .ColumnCount = Rng.Columns.Count
                
                
                    .RowSource = "=" & SheetToFill.Name & "!" & TableAdress & LastLine ' Rw' rng 'SheetToFill.Range(TableAdress & LastLine + 1).Address
                
                    .TopIndex = 0
                End With
        
    End Select
    
End Sub

            Case "cboCEFederalState"

        End Select
    End With
    
End Sub

Public Sub FillLngDict()
Dim Col As String
Dim LngArray
Dim MSONb As Long, _
    LastRow As Long
        
    LngDict.RemoveAll
        
    LastRow = LastRowOfColumn(ShtLNG, 3) - 1
    Col = GetWednesdaysLanguage
    ShtLNG.Range(Col & "1:" & Col & Cells(Rows.Count, Col).End(xlUp).Row).Copy Destination:=ShtLNG.Range("C1")
    LngArray = ShtLNG.Range("A2:C" & CStr(LastRow))
    For MSONb = 1 To LastRow
        If Not LngDict.Exists(LngArray(MSONb, 2)) Then
            On Error Resume Next
            LngDict.Add LngArray(MSONb, 2), LngArray(MSONb, 3)
        End If
    Next MSONb

End Sub

Public Sub EnableStartButton()
Dim MarketNb As Integer, _
    DistNb As Integer
Dim Ctrl As Control, _
    MCtrl As Control, _
    BCtrl As Control
    
    With frmMain
        .cmdStart.Enabled = False
        If StartCheckInfos Then
            If Mid(.txtDCP.value, 4, 2) = "EX" And _
                .txtDate.value <> vbNullString And _
                .txtCollateral.value <> vbNullString And _
                .txtOpenFinRisk.value <> vbNullString And _
                .txtResFinRisk.value <> vbNullString And _
                .txtCollFXRate.value <> vbNullString Then
                
                .txtDCP.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtDate.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtCollateral.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtOpenFinRisk.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtCollFXRate.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtResFinRisk.BackColor = vbWhite
                .txtCollFXRate.BackColor = vbWhite
                .cmdStart.Enabled = True
            Else
                If Mid(.txtDCP.value, 4, 2) <> "EX" Then .txtDCP.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtDCP.BackColor = vbWhite
                If .txtDate.value = vbNullString Or Not AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(CDate(.txtDate.value)) Then .txtDate.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtDate.BackColor = vbWhite
                If .txtCollateral.value = vbNullString Then .txtCollateral.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtCollateral.BackColor = vbWhite
                If .txtOpenFinRisk.value = vbNullString Then .txtOpenFinRisk.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtOpenFinRisk.BackColor = vbWhite
                If .txtResFinRisk.value = vbNullString Then .txtResFinRisk.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtResFinRisk.BackColor = vbWhite
                If .txtCollFXRate.value = vbNullString Then .txtCollFXRate.BackColor = vbRed Else .txtCollFXRate.BackColor = vbWhite
            End If
            TotalDistPercent = 0
            
            For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
                Set MCtrl = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb))
                If MCtrl.value <> vbNullString Then
                    
                    ' Currency
                    Set Ctrl = .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(MarketNb))
                    If Ctrl.value = vbNullString Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbRed
                        .cmdStart.Enabled = False
                    Else
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    End If
                    
                    ' 20240913: Currency check against currency in market definition
                    If MarketCcyDict.item(MCtrl.value) <> Ctrl.value Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbYellow
                        MsgBox "The currency doesn't match the currency of the market!"
                    End If
                    
                    ' Business day
                    Set Ctrl = .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb))
                    If Ctrl.value = vbNullString Or Not IsNumeric(Ctrl.value) Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbRed
                        .cmdStart.Enabled = False
                    Else
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    End If
                    
                    ' Non business day
                    Set Ctrl = .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb))
                    If Ctrl.value = vbNullString Or Not IsNumeric(Ctrl.value) Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbRed
                        .cmdStart.Enabled = False
                    Else
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    End If
                    
                    ' Distribution percentaje
                    Set Ctrl = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MarketNb))
                    If Ctrl.value = vbNullString Or Not IsNumeric(Ctrl.value) Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbRed
                        .cmdStart.Enabled = False
                    Else
                        TotalDistPercent = TotalDistPercent + CInt(Ctrl.value)
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                    End If
                End If
            Next MarketNb
            
            For DistNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
                Set Ctrl = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(DistNb))
                Set MCtrl = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(DistNb))
                Set BCtrl = .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(DistNb))
                Ctrl.ControlTipText = DISTPERCENT_CTT & TotalDistPercent
                If Ctrl.value <> vbNullString And MCtrl.value <> vbNullString Then
                    If TotalDistPercent <> TARGETDISTPERCENT Then
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbRed
                    Else
                        Ctrl.BackColor = vbWhite
                        BCtrl.Picture = .btnBasketActive.Picture
                    End If
                End If
            Next DistNb
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

Public Function IsInArray(stringToFind As String, arr As Variant) As Boolean

    IsInArray = False

    For i = LBound(arr, 1) To UBound(arr, 1)
        If arr(i) = stringToFind Then
            IsInArray = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

End Function

    End If
    
End Function

Sub RetrieveCurrencies()
Dim colCurr As Collection
Dim tmpMarkets, Curr
Dim CurrNb As Integer, _
    LastLine As Integer

    Set colCurr = New Collection
    tmpMarkets = Range("MarketCurrencies").value    ' read all markets in the sheet markets into an array
    For Each Curr In tmpMarkets
        On Error Resume Next
        colCurr.Add Curr, Curr
    Next Curr
    
    ReDim Currencies(colCurr.Count - 1)
    CurrNb = 0
    For Each Curr In colCurr
        Currencies(CurrNb) = Curr
        CurrNb = CurrNb + 1
    Next Curr
    
    For CurrNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        frmMain.Controls("cboCurrency_" & Format(CurrNb, "00")).List = Currencies
    Next CurrNb
    
    frmMain.cboCollCurr.List = Currencies
    frmConfig.cboCECurrency.List = Currencies
    
    ' Write the currencies of each market into a dictionary
    GetMarketsCurrency

End Sub

Function fromUNIX13Digits(uT) As Date
   
   fromUNIX13Digits = CDbl(uT) / 86400000 + DateSerial(1970, 1, 1)

End Function

Function IsThisAUnixTimestamp(value As Variant) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' Versuchen, die Variable als Datum zu interpretieren
    If IsDate(value) Then
        IsThisAUnixTimestamp = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Versuchen, die Variable als Unix-Timestamp zu interpretieren
    If IsNumeric(value) And value >= 0 Then
        Dim testdate As Date
        testdate = DateAdd("s", value, #1/1/1970#)
        If Year(testdate) >= 1970 And Year(testdate) <= 2038 Then ' Unix-Timestamp Gültigkeitsbereich
            IsThisAUnixTimestamp = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    
ErrorHandler:
    IsThisAUnixTimestamp = False
End Function

' Get the date separator
Public Function GetSysDateSep() As String
Dim sFmt As String, _
    sSep As String
 
  ' write date 01.06.2000 in short Date format
  sFmt = Format$(CDate(DateSerial(2000, 6, 1)), "Short Date")
 
  ' detect the separator
  sSep = sFmt
  While IsNumeric(Left$(sSep, 1))
    sSep = Mid$(sSep, 2)
  Wend
  sSep = Left$(sSep, 1)
 
  GetSysDateSep = sSep
  
End Function

' Determine short date format
Public Function GetSysShortDate() As String
Dim sFmt As String
 
  ' Output date 01.06.2000 in the set short date format
  sFmt = Format$(CDate(DateSerial(2000, 6, 1)), "Short Date")
 
  ' Determine date format
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "2000", "yyyy")
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "06", "mm")
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "01", "dd")
 
  ' If the year is only displayed in two digits
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "00", "yy")
 
  ' If month is only displayed in single digit
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "6", "m")
 
  ' If day is only displayed in single digit
  sFmt = Replace(sFmt, "1", "d")
 
  GetSysShortDate = sFmt
  
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: WriteLocalDate
' Purpose: The method converts any date into the date, which is currently configured by the system
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter SourceDate (Variant): The date to convert
' Return Type: Date
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 15.10.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function WriteLocalDate(SourceDate As Variant) As Date
Dim tmpDate As String, _
    tmpDay As String, _
    tmpMonth As String, _
    tmpYear As String, _
    CurrentDateFormat As String, _
    Sep As String, _
    LDCM As String, _
    TMY As String
Dim NoSep As Boolean
    
    CurrentDateFormat = GetSysShortDate    ' Get the current system's region configuration
    LDCM = ShtStart.Range("A39").value     ' last day of current month
    NoSep = True
    Sep = vbNullString
    If InStr(SourceDate, ".") > 0 Then Sep = "."
    If InStr(SourceDate, "-") > 0 Then Sep = "-"
    If InStr(SourceDate, "/") > 0 Then Sep = "/"
    If Sep = vbNullString Then
        If Len(SourceDate) = 8 Then
            If Mid(SourceDate, 1, 3) = "202" Then
                tmpYear = Mid(SourceDate, 1, 4)
                tmpMonth = Mid(SourceDate, 5, 2)
                tmpDay = Mid(SourceDate, 7, 2)
            Else
                tmpDay = Mid(SourceDate, 1, 2)
                tmpMonth = Mid(SourceDate, 3, 2)
                tmpYear = Mid(SourceDate, 5, 4)
            End If
        End If
    End If
    If Split(SourceDate, Sep)(0) > 2000 Then tmpDay = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(2): tmpMonth = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(1): tmpYear = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(0)
    If Split(SourceDate, Sep)(2) > 2000 Then tmpDay = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(0): tmpMonth = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(1): tmpYear = Split(SourceDate, Sep)(2)
    If tmpMonth > 12 Then
        tmpDate = tmpMonth: tmpMonth = tmpDay: tmpDay = tmpDate
    End If
    Select Case CurrentDateFormat
        Case "m/d/yyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpMonth & "/" & tmpDay & "/" & tmpYear)
        Case "dd/mm/yyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpDay & "/" & tmpMonth & "/" & tmpYear)
        Case "dd.mm.yyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpDay & "." & tmpMonth & "." & tmpYear)
        Case "dd-mm-yyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpDay & "-" & tmpMonth & "-" & tmpYear)
        Case "yyyy-mm-dd": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpYear & "-" & tmpMonth & "-" & tmpDay)
        Case "yyyymmdd": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpYear & tmpMonth & tmpDay)
        Case "mmddyyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpMonth & tmpDay & tmpYear)
        Case "ddmmyyyy": WriteLocalDate = CDate(tmpDay & tmpMonth & tmpYear)
    End Select

End Function

Function GetTxt(ByVal lngCode) As String
Dim objXmlHTTP As Object, _
    objRegex As Object, _
    objRegMC As Object
Dim strResponse As String, _
    strSite As String
    
    Set objXmlHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    strSite = "https://countrycode.org/"

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    With objXmlHTTP
        .Open "GET", strSite, False
        .Send
        If .Status = 200 Then strResponse = .ResponseText
    End With
    On Error GoTo 0

    strResponse = Replace(strResponse, "</td><td>", vbNullString)
    Set objRegex = CreateObject("vbscript.regexp")
    With objRegex
        .Pattern = "><td>([a-zA-Z- ]+)[A-Fa-f0-9]{4}" & lngCode
        If .Test(strResponse) Then
            Set objRegMC = .Execute(strResponse)
            GetTxt = objRegMC(0).submatches(0)
        Else
            GetTxt = "Value not found from " & strSite
        End If
    End With
    Set objRegex = Nothing
    Set objXmlHTTP = Nothing
    Exit Function
ErrHandler:
        If Not objXmlHTTP Is Nothing Then Set objXmlHTTP = Nothing
        GetTxt = strSite & " unable to be accessed"
End Function

Public Function GetWednesdaysLanguage() As String
Dim TheDay As String
    
    TheDay = Format$(CDate(DateSerial(2000, 5, 31)), "dddd")
    
    Select Case Format$(CDate(DateSerial(2000, 5, 31)), "dddd")
        Case "Mittwoch": GetWednesdaysLanguage = "D"
        Case "Mercredi": GetWednesdaysLanguage = "E"
        Case "Wednesday": GetWednesdaysLanguage = "F"
        Case "Mercoledì": GetWednesdaysLanguage = "G"
        Case "miércoles": GetWednesdaysLanguage = "H"
    End Select

End Function

Function WriteDateInLanguage(theDate As String) As String
    Dim CurrentDate As Date
    Dim LanguageID As Long
    Dim OutputDate As String
    Dim SystemLanguage As String
    Dim LangCode As Long
    Dim LangSettingsCode As Long

    ' Aktuelles Datum
    CurrentDate = theDate

    ' Spracheinstellung aus Excel ermitteln
    LanguageID = Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDUI)   '  1036  (Die Sprache Französisch)
    ' LangCode = Application.International(xlCountrySetting) ' xlCountrySetting
    LangCode = Application.International(xlCountryCode) ' xlCountrySetting  ' 33
    LangSettingsCode = Application.International(xlCountrySetting) ' xlCountrySetting   ' 39=(Italy)
    ' Datumsausgabe je nach Sprache
    OutputDate = Fmt.MSOLangName
    Select Case GetWednesdaysLanguage
        Case "D": SystemLanguage = "Systemsprache ist Deutsch und dieses Datum ist "
        Case "E": SystemLanguage = "La langue du système est le français, et cette date est "
        Case "F": SystemLanguage = "System language is English, and this date is "
        Case "G": SystemLanguage = "La lingua del sistema è l'italiano e la data è "
        Case "H": SystemLanguage = "El idioma del sistema es el español, y esta fecha es el "
    End Select
    
    Select Case LangCode
        Case 1 ' USEnglisch
            OutputDate = "The Excel's language is british english, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd, dd mmmm yyyy")
        Case 49 ' Deutsch
            OutputDate = "Die Excel-Sprache ist Deutsch, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd, dd. mmmm yyyy")
        Case 1033 ' Englisch
            OutputDate = "The Excel's language is british english, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd, dd mmmm yyyy")
        Case 33 ' Französisch  ' 1036  (Die Sprache Französisch) ´39
            OutputDate = "La Excel langue est le français, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd dd mmmm yyyy")
        Case 39 ' Spanisch
            OutputDate = "El idioma de Excel es el español, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd dd, mmmm, yyyy")
        Case 34 ' Italienisch
            OutputDate = "La lingua è il tedesco e questa data, " & SystemLanguage & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd dd mmmm yyyy")
        Case Else
            OutputDate = "Language not supported. The date is: " & Format(CurrentDate, "dddd, dd mmmm yyyy")
    End Select

    ' Ausgabe des Datums in einer MessageBox
    ' MsgBox OutputDate, vbInformation, "Datumsausgabe"
    
    WriteDateInLanguage = OutputDate
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CollectData
' Purpose: The method collects the data from Kathrin's output-sheet
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 04.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub CollectData()
Dim arrOutput As Variant
Dim lngOutputLine As Long
Dim varOutPutRecord As clsOutputSheet

    arrOutput = ShtOutput.Range("A4:K" & ShtOutput.Range("A" & ShtOutput.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row)
    Set varOutPutRecord = New clsOutputSheet
    OutputSheetDict.RemoveAll
    For lngOutputLine = 1 To UBound(arrOutput)
        With varOutPutRecord
            .bd_0 = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 1)
            .DCP = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 2)
            .Market = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 3)
            .Ccy = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 4)
            .d_i = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 5)
            .FlagPaymentDay = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 6)
            .FlagResetAndECCBusinessDay = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 7)
            .BaseValuesDistributed = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 8)
            .BaseLimit = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 9)
            .BaseExposureInMarketCurrency = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 10)
            .BaseExposureInCollateralCurrency = arrOutput(lngOutputLine, 11)
            
            OutPK = .bd_0 & "_" & _
                    .Market & "_" & _
                    .d_i
        End With
        OutputSheetDict.Add OutPK, varOutPutRecord
        Set varOutPutRecord = New clsOutputSheet
    Next lngOutputLine
    
End Sub


' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CreateHTML
' Purpose: The method creates the HTML-file for output in the internal browser window. Furthermore,
'          it fills out the appropriate PDF template for storing the content in a PDF file
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 07.08.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub CreateHTML()
Dim PrimaryKey As String, _
    PK2 As String, _
    ExplainAvailExColl As String, _
    ExplainDynamicLimit As String, _
    ExplainTradingLimit1800 As String, _
    ExplainTradingLimit0900 As String, _
    LimitCurrency As String, _
    Converted As String, _
    sMNb As String, _
    sPlNb As String

Dim MarketNb As Integer, _
    FigureLine As Integer, _
    MarketCol As Integer, _
    PDFLine As Integer
Dim PrintPos As clsPrintPositions
Dim HTMLLine As Variant
Dim dblResFinRisk As Double, _
    dblAvailableCollateral As Double
    
    CleanUpTplPDF
    PrepareOutput           ' The method fills an dictionary with the appropriate positions of information in PDF sheet
    
    GetFigurePositions
    MarketCol = 13          ' In the DCPLimitCalculation sheet it starts always in column "M" = 13
    
    GetHTMLHeaderLines
    
    FileName = "Output.html"
    FondSize = "20"
    sFile = CurrPath & FileName
    
    'This will never throw an error
    On Error Resume Next
    If Len(Dir(sFile)) > 0 Then
        SetAttr sFile, vbNormal
        Kill sFile
    End If

    ' *** Write the header of the HTML file *******************************************
    FileNumber = FreeFile                   ' Get unused file number
    Open sFile For Output As #FileNumber ' Connect to the file
    
    For Each HTMLLine In HTMLHeaderDict
        Print #FileNumber, HTMLHeaderDict.item(HTMLLine)
    Next HTMLLine
    ' *********************************************************************************
    
    OutAvailableCollateral = Format(frmMain.txtCollateral, TWODECIMALS)
    dblAvailableCollateral = CDbl(OutAvailableCollateral)
    
    OutOpenRisk = frmMain.txtOpenFinRisk.value
    
    ' --- check if the sum of all base exposures is lower than collateral - otherwise it raises a warning
    
    FontStart = vbNullString
    FontEnd = vbNullString
    ExplainBaseExposure = vbNullString
    CollCurrency = frmMain.cboCollCurr.value
    CollExchangeRate = CDbl(frmMain.txtCollFXRate.value)
    
    ' --- Base exposure -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    OutBaseExposure = SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency
            
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        sMNb = CStr(MarketNb)
        Call ResetBDANBDADist(MarketNb)   ' set the values of BDA, NBDA and Dist by empty markets to null
        
        ExplainAvailExColl = vbNullString
        ExplainDynamicLimit = vbNullString
        ExplainTradingLimit1800 = vbNullString
        ExplainTradingLimit0900 = vbNullString
        frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & sMNb).Tag = vbNullString
        
        If OutMarket <> vbNullString And MarketInOutput(OutMarket) Then     ' but if we have a valid market ...
        
            frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & sMNb).Tag = "Print2PDF"
            PrimaryKey = frmMain.txtDate.value & "_" & OutMarket & "_" & frmMain.txtDate.value
            PK2 = frmMain.txtDate.value & "_" & OutMarket & "_" & DateAdd("d", 1, frmMain.txtDate.value)
            
            ' --- Trading limit 16:00 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            FigureLine = FigurePosDict.item("Collateral:")
            OutTradingLimit1600 = OutputSheetDict.item(PK2).BaseLimit
            
            With ShtLimitCalc
                ' now write this calculated value into the limit calc sheet ...
                .Range(.Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb), .Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb)).value = CStr(OutTradingLimit1600)
            End With
            
                        
            ' --- Available collaterals -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            OutAvailableExcessCollateral = Format(dblAvailableCollateral - CDbl(OutBaseExposure) - CDbl(OutOpenRisk), TWODECIMALS)
            
            ExplainAvailExColl = "Available Excess Collateral is the result of Available Collateral (" & Format(OutAvailableCollateral, "#,##" & TWODECIMALS) & " " & CollCurrency & _
                                 ") minus Base Exposure (" & Format(OutBaseExposure, "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & _
                                 ") minus Open Risk (" & Format(OutOpenRisk, "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & ")"
                                 
                                 
                                 
            ' --- Market distribution percent -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            OutxMarketDistribution = CDbl(frmMain.Controls("txtDist_0" & sMNb).value)
            
            
            ' Limits currency, we need this later for decision, if we have to calculate exchanges
            LimitCurrency = frmMain.Controls("cboCurrency_0" & sMNb).value
                                
                                
            ' --- Limit reset days -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            If UCase(MarketLimitResetDict.item(OutMarket)) = "BUSINESS DAY" Or _
               InStr(OutMarket, "EPEX_CPCTY_EUR") > 0 Or _
               InStr(OutMarket, ", EEX_GOFR_EUR") > 0 Or _
               InStr(OutMarket, "EPEX_GOEU_EUR") > 0 Then
                OutxLimitResetDays = 1
                LRDayDescription = IIf(UCase(MarketLimitResetDict.item(OutMarket)) = "BUSINESS DAY", "for continuous markets", "for markets = " & OutMarket) & " it is always 1, because of definition Limit Reset on each BUSINESS DAY"
            Else
                LRDayDescription = vbNullString
                OutxLimitResetDays = DaysUntilNextBizDay(CollCurrency, frmMain.txtDate.value)
                
                If OutxLimitResetDays = 1 Then
                    LRDayDescription = "The next business day after the trading day is the following calendar day (" & DateAdd("d", 1, frmMain.txtDate.value) & ")"
                Else
                    ' LPRDayDescription = "The trading day (" & frmMain.txtDate.Value & ") is a " & WeekdayName(Weekday(frmMain.txtDate.Value, 0), False, 0)
                    Dim tmpDate As Date
                    tmpDate = DateAdd("d", OutxLimitResetDays, frmMain.txtDate.value)
                    If Not specialDay Then
                        LRDayDescription = "The next trading day is in " & OutxLimitResetDays & " days,<BR>at " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(tmpDate) & " the " & tmpDate
                    End If
                    
                    If ExistsInCollection(colHoliday, frmMain.txtDate.value) Then
                        
                    End If
                End If
            End If
            
            With ShtLimitCalc
                ' now write this calculated value into the limit calc sheet ...
                .Range(.Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb), .Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb)).value = CStr(OutTradingLimit1600)
            End With
            
            
            
            ' --- Dynamic Limit -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            OutDynamicLimit = (CDbl(OutAvailableExcessCollateral) * (CDbl(OutxMarketDistribution) / 100)) / OutxLimitResetDays
            
            ExplainDynamicLimit = "Dynamic Limit is the result of Available Excess Collateral (" & Format(OutAvailableExcessCollateral, "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & _
                                  ") * Percent of Market distribution (" & Format(OutxMarketDistribution, "#,##0.00") & _
                                  ") / 100) divided by Limit Reset days (" & OutxLimitResetDays & ")"
            
            If CollCurrency = EURO And LimitCurrency = POUND Then
                OutDynamicLimit = CDbl(OutDynamicLimit) * CollExchangeRate
                ExplainDynamicLimit = ExplainDynamicLimit & "<BR> In case of collateral currency=" & EUROSYMBOL & " and limit currency=" & POUNDSYMBOL & ", we multiply the dynamic limit with the collateral exchange rate of " & CollExchangeRate
            End If
            
            ' new since 20250107
            If CollCurrency = POUND And LimitCurrency = EURO Then
                OutDynamicLimit = CDbl(OutDynamicLimit) * CollExchangeRate
                ExplainDynamicLimit = ExplainDynamicLimit & "<BR> In case of collateral currency=" & POUNDSYMBOL & " and limit currency=" & EUROSYMBOL & " , we multiply the dynamic limit with the collateral exchange rate of " & CollExchangeRate
            End If
            
            FigureLine = FigurePosDict.item("Dynamic Limit:")
            With ShtLimitCalc
                ' now write this calculated value into the limit calc sheet ...
                .Range(.Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb), .Cells(FigureLine, MarketCol + sMNb)).value = CStr(OutDynamicLimit)
            End With
            
            
            
            ' --- Plus base limit -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            OutPlusBaseLimit = Format(OutputSheetDict.item(PK2).BaseLimit, TWODECIMALS)
            
            ' --- Trading limit 18:00 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            OutTradingLimit1800 = CDbl(OutDynamicLimit) + CDbl(OutPlusBaseLimit)
            ExplainTradingLimit1800 = "Trading Limit 1800 is the summary of dynamic limit (" & Format(OutDynamicLimit, "#,##0.00") & " " & OutputSheetDict.item(PK2).Ccy & _
                                      ") and Base limit (" & Format(OutPlusBaseLimit, "#,##0.00") & " " & OutputSheetDict.item(PK2).Ccy & ")"
            
            ' --- Trading limit 09:00 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            
            Converted = vbNullString
            dblResFinRisk = CDbl((frmMain.txtResFinRisk.value))
            
            If CollCurrency = POUND And LimitCurrency = EURO Then
                dblResFinRisk = dblResFinRisk * CollExchangeRate
                Converted = ", converted in GBP = " & CStr(dblResFinRisk)
            End If
            If CollCurrency = EURO And LimitCurrency = POUND Then
                dblResFinRisk = dblResFinRisk * CollExchangeRate
                Converted = ", converted in GBP = " & CStr(dblResFinRisk)
            End If
            
            
            OutTradingLimit0900 = (CDbl(OutTradingLimit1800) + dblResFinRisk * CDbl(OutxMarketDistribution) / 100)

            
            Dim C2 As String ' Currency
            C2 = OutputSheetDict.item(PK2).Ccy
            ExplainTradingLimit0900 = "Trading Limit 0900 is the result of trading limit 18:00 (" & Format(OutTradingLimit1800, "#,##0.00") & " " & C2 & _
                                      ") <BR>plus (financial risk (" & Format(frmMain.txtResFinRisk.value, "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & Converted & _
                                      ") <BR>multiplied by " & OutxMarketDistribution & "% = " & _
                                      " " & Format(dblResFinRisk / 100 * CDbl(OutxMarketDistribution), "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & ") = " & _
                                      Format((CDbl(OutTradingLimit1800) + CDbl((frmMain.txtResFinRisk.value)) * CDbl(OutxMarketDistribution) / 100), "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency
            Debug.Print ExplainTradingLimit0900
            
            If CollCurrency = EURO And LimitCurrency = POUND Then
                
                OutTradingLimit0900 = (CDbl(OutTradingLimit1800) + dblResFinRisk * CDbl(OutxMarketDistribution) / 100)

                Debug.Print ExplainTradingLimit0900
            End If
                                                  
            
            If OutMarket <> vbNullString Then
                ' ---------------------------------------------------
                ' Write HTML:
                ' ---------------------------------------------------
                Print #FileNumber, "        <H3> Market: " & OutMarket & " </H3>"
                Print #FileNumber, "        <TABLE class = ""TABLEDetails"">"
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn("16:00 CET") & "<TD width=600><B>Trading limit</B>     </TD>" & CommentTag & Format(OutTradingLimit1600, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(COMENTTradingLimit1600) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(LimitCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn() & FinalColumn()
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("Available Collateral") & CommentTag & Format(OutAvailableCollateral, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(COMENTAvailableCollateral) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(CollCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("BaseExposure") & CommentTag & FontStart & Format(OutBaseExposure, TWODECIMALS) & FontEnd & CellComment(ExplainBaseExposure) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(CollCurrency))
                
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("Open Risk") & CommentTag & Format(OutOpenRisk, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(COMENTOpenRisk) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(CollCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("<B>Available Excess Collateral</B>") & CommentTag & Format(OutAvailableExcessCollateral, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(ExplainAvailExColl) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(CollCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("x market distribution") & CommentTag & Format(OutxMarketDistribution, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(COMENTxMarketDistribution) & FinalColumn("%")
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("x limit reset days") & CommentTag & Format(OutxLimitResetDays, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(LRDayDescription) & FinalColumn("d")
                
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("<B>Dynamic Limit</B>") & CommentTag & Format(OutDynamicLimit, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(ExplainDynamicLimit) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(LimitCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn("+ Base limit") & CommentTag & Format(OutPlusBaseLimit, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(COMENTPlusBaseLimit) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(LimitCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn("18:00 CET") & ItemColumn("<B>Trading limit</B>") & CommentTag & Format(OutTradingLimit1800, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(ExplainTradingLimit1800) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(LimitCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn() & ItemColumn() & FinalColumn()
                Print #FileNumber, FirstColumn("09:00 CET (t+1)") & ItemColumn("<B>Trading limit</B>") & CommentTag & Format(OutTradingLimit0900, TWODECIMALS) & CellComment(ExplainTradingLimit0900) & FinalColumn(CcySymbol(LimitCurrency))
                Print #FileNumber, "       </TABLE>"
                ' ---------------------------------------------------
                ' Write into template sheet for PDF
                ' ---------------------------------------------------

                Set PrintPos = PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(MarketNb)
                
                With PrintPos
                    PDFLine = Range("PDFMarket" & sMNb).Row
                    sPlNb = CStr(PDFLine)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("PDFMarket" & sMNb).value = "Market: " & OutMarket
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 1).value = Format(OutTradingLimit1600, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(LimitCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 2).value = Format(OutAvailableCollateral, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(CollCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 3).value = Format(OutBaseExposure, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(CollCurrency)
                    
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 4).value = CStr(Format(OutOpenRisk, TWODECIMALS)) & " " & CcySymbol(CollCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 5).value = Format(OutAvailableExcessCollateral, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(CollCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 6).value = Format(OutxMarketDistribution, TWODECIMALS) & " %"
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 7).value = Format(OutxLimitResetDays, TWODECIMALS) & " d"
                    
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 8).value = Format(OutDynamicLimit, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(LimitCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 9).value = Format(OutPlusBaseLimit, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(LimitCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 10).value = Format(OutTradingLimit1800, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(LimitCurrency)
                    ShtTplPDF.Range("G" & sPlNb + 11).value = Format(OutTradingLimit0900, TWODECIMALS) & " " & CcySymbol(LimitCurrency)
                End With
                                
            End If
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    
    
    Print #FileNumber, "    </BODY>"
    Print #FileNumber, "</HTML>"
    
    
    Close #FileNumber
        
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: MarketInOutput
' Purpose: The function checks, if a giveen market is mentioned in the output sheet
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Private
' Parameter ThisMarket (String): The market, for which we ask for
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 06.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Function MarketInOutput(ThisMarket As String) As Boolean
Dim Market As Variant, _
    MyRange As Variant
Dim LastLine As Integer
    
    With ShtOutput
        LastLine = .Range("C" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
        MarketInOutputDict.RemoveAll
        MyRange = .Range(.Cells(5, 3), .Cells(LastLine, 3))
    End With
    
    With MarketInOutputDict
        For Each Market In MyRange
            If Not .Exists(Market) Then
                .Add Market, Market
            End If
        
        Next Market
        MarketInOutput = .Exists(ThisMarket)
    End With
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetFigurePositions
' Purpose: The function checks, if a given market is mentioned in the output sheet
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Private
' Parameter ThisMarket (String): The market, for which we ask for
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 06.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub GetFigurePositions()
Dim LastLine As Integer, _
    ThisLine As Integer
Dim MyRange As Variant, _
    Figure As Variant

    With ShtLimitCalc
        LastLine = .Range("M" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
        FigurePosDict.RemoveAll
        MyRange = .Range(.Cells(2, 13), .Cells(LastLine, 13))
    End With
    
    ThisLine = 2
    With FigurePosDict
        For Each Figure In MyRange
            If Not .Exists(Figure) Then
                .Add Figure, ThisLine
                ThisLine = ThisLine + 1
            End If
        
        Next Figure
    End With
        
End Sub

Private Function SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency() As Double
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim PrimaryKey As String, _
    MarketCurrency As String
Dim MarketsBaseExposure As Double

   For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        ' Get the market
        OutMarket = frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
        
        ' if we have data:
        If OutMarket <> vbNullString And MarketInOutput(OutMarket) Then
            ' PK for accessing the dictionary
            PrimaryKey = frmMain.txtDate.value & "_" & OutMarket & "_" & frmMain.txtDate.value
                
            ' get the markets currency from the dictionary
            MarketCurrency = OutputSheetDict.item(PrimaryKey).Ccy
            
            'get the markets base exposure from the dictionary
            MarketsBaseExposure = CDbl(OutputSheetDict.item(PrimaryKey).BaseExposureInMarketCurrency)
            
            ' if the market currencies are different from collateral currency...
            If MarketCurrency <> CollCurrency Then
                ' calculate the amount of exposure with the exchange rate
                OutBaseExposure = MarketsBaseExposure / CollExchangeRate
                ExplainBaseExposure = ExplainBaseExposure & "<BR>" & MarketNb & ".: Market's base exposure " & Format(MarketsBaseExposure, "#,##0.00") & " " & MarketCurrency & " is converted to " & CollCurrency & " (" & Format(OutBaseExposure, "#,##0.00") & " " & CollCurrency & ")"
            Else
                ' or tage the original value
                OutBaseExposure = OutputSheetDict.item(PrimaryKey).BaseExposureInMarketCurrency
                ExplainBaseExposure = ExplainBaseExposure & "<BR>" & MarketNb & ".: Market's base exposure " & Format(OutBaseExposure, "#,##0.00") & " " & MarketCurrency & " is not converted"
            End If
            
            ' collect all (calculated) values together
            SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency = SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency + OutBaseExposure
            
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    
    ExplainBaseExposure = ExplainBaseExposure & ".<BR><BR>The summary of all converted market base exposures is " & Format(SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency, "#,##0.00") & CollCurrency
    ExplainBaseExposure = Replace(ExplainBaseExposure, "<BR>1.:", "1.:")
    
    If SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency > CDbl(frmMain.txtCollateral.value) Then
        FontStart = "<font color=""red"">"
        FontEnd = "</font>"
        frmMain.txtCollateral.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "Warning! Base exposure (" & SumAllOpenExposuresByCurrency & ") larger than Collateral (" & frmMain.txtCollateral.value & "), " & vbCrLf & _
               "Base limit or Collateral must be adjusted. Calculation is incorrect!", vbExclamation, "Base exposures larger than collateral!"
        frmMain.txtCollateral.BackColor = vbWhite
    End If
    
End Function

Public Sub SaveOutput2PDF()
Dim PDFFilePath As String
Dim ret As Variant

    PDFFilePath = CurrPath & "PrintOutput.pdf"

    ret = IsPDFFileOpen(PDFFilePath)

    If ret = True Then
        MsgBox "The PDF-File is still open, please close it", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    With ShtPDF
        .Visible = xlSheetVisible
        .Select
        .PageSetup.PrintArea = PrintArea       'set the printarea
        .ExportAsFixedFormat Type:=xlTypePDF, FileName:=PDFFilePath, OpenAfterPublish:=True
        .Visible = xlSheetHidden
    End With
    
    MsgBox "PDF file " & PDFFilePath & " is saved.", vbInformation
        
End Sub

Public Sub CompileFinalPDF()
Dim FooterPosition As String, _
    TplPosition As String, _
    FinalPosition As String, _
    LastLine As String, _
    O09TextLine As String, _
    shpName As String
Dim MarketNb As Integer, _
    LastMarketNb As Integer, _
    MarketFound As Integer, _
    Line As Integer, _
    LogoHeight As Integer, _
    LogoWidth As Integer
Dim OutputNb As Byte
Dim shp As Shape

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ThisWorkbook.Unprotect ShtPDFPW
    ThisWorkbook.Sheets("PDF").Visible = xlSheetVisible
    ThisWorkbook.Sheets("PDF").Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add.Name = "PDF"
    Set ShtPDF = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(SHTPDF_NAME)
    ShtPDF.Select
    ' ShtPDF.Visible = xlSheetHidden
    MarketFound = 0
    LastMarketNb = 0
    FooterPosition = 0

    ' define the width of PDF columns
    With ShtPDF
        .Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 3#
        .Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12.55
        .Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 9.55
        .Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 5.36
        .Columns("E:E").ColumnWidth = 12.55
        .Columns("F:F").ColumnWidth = 12.27
        .Columns("G:G").ColumnWidth = 9.45
        .Rows(5).RowHeight = 5
        For Line = 6 To 48: .Rows(Line).RowHeight = 14: Next Line
        For Line = 51 To 88: .Rows(Line).RowHeight = 14: Next Line
        For Line = 100 To 137: .Rows(Line).RowHeight = 14: Next Line
        
        .Rows(10).RowHeight = 32
    End With
    
    ' retrieve values from the user main form
    With frmMain
        ShtTplPDF.Range("C3").value = .txtDCP.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("F3").value = .txtDate.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("C4").value = .lblCalendar.Caption
        ShtTplPDF.Range("C6").value = .txtCollateral.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("F6").value = .txtOpenFinRisk.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("C7").value = .cboCollCurr.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("F7").value = .txtResFinRisk.value
        ShtTplPDF.Range("C8").value = .txtCollFXRate.value
        
        ' this writes line per line the table with the selected markets and their parameters
        OutputNb = 0
        For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
            If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Tag = "Print2PDF" Then
                OutputNb = OutputNb + 1
                ShtTplPDF.Range("B1" & CStr(OutputNb)).value = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                ShtTplPDF.Range("D1" & CStr(OutputNb)).value = .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                ShtTplPDF.Range("E1" & CStr(OutputNb)).value = .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                ShtTplPDF.Range("F1" & CStr(OutputNb)).value = .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                ShtTplPDF.Range("G1" & CStr(OutputNb)).value = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                LastMarketNb = MarketNb
            End If
        Next MarketNb

    End With
    
    
    ' This writes the first headline ...
    ShtTplPDF.Range(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(1).Headline).Copy ShtPDF.Range("A1")
    
    ' This writes the table with initial parameters and the market data ...
    ShtTplPDF.Range("B3:G1" & CStr(LastMarketNb)).Copy ShtPDF.Range("B3")
    
    O09TextLine = CStr(LastMarketNb + 11)
    With Range("B" & O09TextLine & ":G" & O09TextLine)
        .Merge
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignLeft
        .VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignTop
    End With
    With ShtPDF.Range("B" & O09TextLine)
        .value = ShtTplPDF.Range("B19").Value2
        .RowHeight = 32
    End With
    ShtPDF.Hyperlinks.Add ShtPDF.Range("B" & O09TextLine), O09URL
    ShtPDF.Range("B" & O09TextLine).Font.Size = 8
    
    OutputNb = 0
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        ' in case a market is defined ...
        If frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Tag = "Print2PDF" Then
            OutputNb = OutputNb + 1
            ' it reads the defined range with market information ...
            FinalPosition = PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(OutputNb).TableRange
            TplPosition = PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(MarketNb).TableRange
            
            ' ... and writes this range into the destination sheet
            ShtTplPDF.Range(TplPosition).Copy ShtPDF.Range(FinalPosition)
            
            ' in case of the 3th or 6th market it writes the disclaimer in the appropriate area of the destination sheet
            If OutputNb = 3 Or OutputNb = 6 Then
                ShtTplPDF.Range(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(1).Headline).Copy ShtPDF.Range(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(OutputNb).Headline)
            End If
            
            LastMarketNb = MarketNb
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    
    ' ShtTplPDF.Range(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.Item(3).DISCLAIMER).Copy ShtPDF.Range(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.Item(LastMarketNb).DISCLAIMER)
    LastLine = Replace(PDF_ItemPositionsDict.item(LastMarketNb).DISCLAIMER, "B", vbNullString)
    With ShtPDF.Range("B" & LastLine & ":G" & LastLine + 3)
        .Font.Size = 7
        .MergeCells = True
        .WrapText = True
        .value = DISCLAIMER
    End With
    ShtPDF.Rows(LastLine).RowHeight = 21#
    PrintArea = "A1:H" & CStr(CInt(LastLine) + 3)
    
    ' This writes the page breaks
    ShtPDF.HPageBreaks.Add Before:=Range("A47")
    ShtPDF.HPageBreaks.Add Before:=Range("A90")
    
    
    For Each shp In ShtTplPDF.Shapes
        If shp.Type = msoPicture Then
            LogoHeight = shp.Height  ' 20
            LogoWidth = shp.Width    ' 75
        End If
    Next shp
    
    For Each shp In ShtPDF.Shapes
        If shp.Type = msoPicture Then
            shp.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
            shp.Height = LogoHeight
            shp.Width = LogoWidth
        End If
    Next shp
        
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: PrepareOutput
' Purpose: The method initiates the filling of information in the position dictionary
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 05.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub PrepareOutput()

    ' Init the dictionary
    PDF_ItemPositionsDict.RemoveAll
    
' Page 1:
    Call FillPP(1, 1, 20)  ' Page 1, Market 1, Line 20
    Call FillPP(1, 2, 33)  ' Page 1, Market 2, Line 33
    
' Page 2:
    Call FillPP(2, 3, 48)  ' Page 2, Market 3, Line 48
    Call FillPP(2, 4, 61)  ' Page 2, Market 4, Line 61
    Call FillPP(2, 5, 76)  ' Page 2, Market 5, Line 76
    
' Page 3:
    Call FillPP(3, 6, 98) ' Page 3, Market 6, Line 98
    Call FillPP(3, 7, 110) ' Page 3, Market 7, Line 110
    Call FillPP(3, 8, 123) ' Page 3, Market 8, Line 123
        
End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: FillPP
' Purpose: The method fills an dictionary with the appropriate
' positions of information in the template sheet for PDF output
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Private
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 05.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Sub FillPP(Page As Integer, MarketNb As Integer, Raw As Integer)
Dim LNb As Integer

    Set PP = New clsPrintPositions
    With PP
        Debug.Print Range("PDFMarket1").Address
        LNb = Range("PDFMarket" & CStr(MarketNb)).Row
        .Market = "B" & CStr(LNb + 0)
        .TradingLimit1600 = "G" & CStr(LNb + 1)

Function IsPDFFileOpen(PDFFileName As String)
Dim ff As Long, _
    ErrNo As Long

    On Error Resume Next
    ff = FreeFile()
    Open PDFFileName For Input Lock Read As #ff
    Close ff
    ErrNo = Err
    On Error GoTo 0

    Select Case ErrNo
        Case 53, 0:   IsPDFFileOpen = False
        Case 70:  IsPDFFileOpen = True
        Case Else: Error ErrNo
    End Select
    
End Function

Function EasterSunday(ByVal intYear As Integer) As Date
    
Dim G As Integer, _
    C As Integer, _
    H As Integer, _
    i As Integer, _
    j As Integer, _
    L As Integer, _
    intMonth As Integer, _
    intDay As Integer

    G = intYear Mod 19
    C = intYear \ 100
    H = (C - (C \ 4) - ((8 * C + 13) \ 25) + 19 * G + 15) Mod 30
    i = H - (H \ 28) * (1 - (H \ 28) * (29 \ (H + 1)) * ((21 - G) \ 11))
    j = (intYear + (intYear \ 4) + i + 2 - C + (C \ 4)) Mod 7
    L = i - j
    intMonth = 3 + (L + 40) \ 44
    intDay = L + 28 - 31 * (intMonth \ 4)
    
    EasterSunday = DateSerial(intYear, intMonth, intDay)

End Function
