' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetAllHolidaysDates
' Purpose: The procedure assignes the dates to the appropriate holiday names
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter intYear (Integer): the year, for which the date should be calculated
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 23.05.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub GetAllHolidaysDates(TradingCurrency As String, intYear As Integer)
Dim CalendarCode As String, _
    CustName1 As String, _
    CustName2 As String, _
    CustName3 As String, _
    CustName4 As String, _
    CustName5 As String
Dim clsHoliday As clsHolidays
Dim datEaster As Date, _
    CustDate1 As Date, _
    CustDate2 As Date, _
    CustDate3 As Date, _
    CustDate4 As Date, _
    CustDate5 As Date
Dim TheYear As Integer, _
    DestYear As Integer, _
    CalendarYear As Integer, _
    CNb As Integer
Dim strcNb As String
Dim Customer(5) As CustType
    
    HolidayDateDict.RemoveAll
    DestYear = intYear + 10
    
    For TheYear = intYear - 5 To DestYear
        datEaster = EasterSunday(TheYear)
        Set clsHoliday = New clsHolidays
            
        clsHoliday.NewYearsDay = DateSerial(TheYear, 1, 1)                '  1. Neujahrstag
        clsHoliday.GoodFriday = datEaster - 2                             '  2. Karfreitag
        clsHoliday.EasterMonday = datEaster + 1                           '  3. Ostermontag
        clsHoliday.labourDay = DateSerial(TheYear, 5, 1)                  '  4. Tag der Arbeit
        clsHoliday.EarlyMayBankHoliday = GetEarlyMayBankHoliday(TheYear)  '  5. Erster MaiMontag  (GB)
        clsHoliday.SpringBankHoliday = GetSpringBankHoliday(TheYear)      '  6. Frühlingsfeiertag (GB)
        clsHoliday.SummerBankHoliday = GetSummerBankHoliday(TheYear)      '  7. Sommerfeiertag    (GB)
        clsHoliday.ChristmasDay = DateSerial(TheYear, 12, 25)             '  8. Weihnachten
        clsHoliday.BoxingDay = DateSerial(TheYear, 12, 26)                '  9. Zweiter Weihnachtsfeiertag
        
        If TradingCurrency = POUND Then
            ' --- Special UK calendar regarding christmas day and boxing day -------------------------------------
            ' If Boxing Day falls on a Saturday, the following Monday is a substitute bank holiday.
            ' If Christmas Day falls on a Saturday, the following Monday and Tuesday are substitute bank holidays.
            ' The bank holiday is a time for many people to relax and enjoy a day off from work.
            If clsHoliday.BoxingDay = vbSaturday Then
                clsHoliday.SubstituteDay1 = DateSerial(TheYear, 12, 28)   '  10. Erster Ersatzfeiertag
            End If
            If clsHoliday.ChristmasDay = vbSaturday Then
                clsHoliday.SubstituteDay1 = DateSerial(TheYear, 12, 27)   '  11. Erster Ersatzfeiertag
                clsHoliday.SubstituteDay2 = DateSerial(TheYear, 12, 28)   '  12. Zweiter Ersatzfeiertag
            End If
            ' This will be happen next time 2026 where boxing day is Saturday and
            ' then 2027 where Christmas day is SDaturday and Boxing day Sunday
            ' -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        End If
            
        CalendarCode = Mid(ShtHolidays.Range("SelectedCalendar").value, 1, 2)
        CalendarYear = ShtHolidays.Range("CalendarYear").value
        
        For CNb = 1 To 5
            strcNb = CStr(CNb)
            Customer(CNb).cDate = ReplaceSeparator("CustVal" & strcNb)
            Customer(CNb).cName = ShtHolidays.Range("CustName" & strcNb).value
        Next CNb
                
        If CalendarCode <> vbNullString Then
            
            If ShtHolidays.Range(CalendarCode & "Cust1").value = "x" And CalendarYear = Year(CustDate1) Then
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday1 = Customer(CNb).cDate
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday1Name = Customer(CNb).cName
            End If
            If ShtHolidays.Range(CalendarCode & "Cust2").value = "x" And CalendarYear = Year(CustDate2) Then
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday2 = Customer(2).cDate
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday2Name = CustName2
            End If
            If ShtHolidays.Range(CalendarCode & "Cust3").value = "x" And CalendarYear = Year(CustDate3) Then
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday3 = Customer(3).cDate
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday3Name = CustName3
            End If
            If ShtHolidays.Range(CalendarCode & "Cust4").value = "x" And CalendarYear = Year(CustDate4) Then
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday4 = Customer(4).cDate
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday4Name = CustName4
            End If
            
            If ShtHolidays.Range(CalendarCode & "Cust5").value = "x" And CalendarYear = Year(CustDate5) Then
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday5 = Customer(5).cDate
                clsHoliday.CustHoliday5Name = CustName5
            End If
        End If   ' of calendarcode <> empty
        
        HolidayDateDict.Add TheYear, clsHoliday
        
    Next TheYear
    
End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: Holidays
' Purpose: The method fills a dictionary based on information if a holiday is selected or not
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter intYear (Integer): the appropriate year
' Return Type: Collection
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 08.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function Holidays(TradingCurrency As String, ByVal intYear As Integer) As Collection
Dim HC As String
Dim datEaster As Date
Dim arrHD As Variant
Dim arrCU As Variant
Dim FirstLine As Integer, _
    LastLine As Integer
Dim FL As String, _
    LL As String

    Set colHoliday = New Collection
    
    HC = IIf(TradingCurrency = EURO, HCOL_T2, HCOL_GB)
    ReDim arrHD(1 To MAXHOLIDAYS)
    FirstLine = 4: FL = CStr(FirstLine)
    LastLine = FirstLine + MAXHOLIDAYS - 1: LL = CStr(LastLine)
    arrHD = ShtHolidays.Range(HC & FL & ":" & HC & LL)
    arrCU = ShtHolidays.Range(HCOL_CU & FL & ":" & HCOL_CU & LL)
    
    datEaster = EasterSunday(intYear)
    
    If arrHD(1, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(1, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).NewYearsDay
    If arrHD(2, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(2, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).GoodFriday                       '  2. Karfreitag
    If arrHD(3, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(3, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EasterMonday                     '  3. Ostermontag
    If arrHD(4, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(4, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).labourDay                        '  4. EarlyMayBankHoliday
    If arrHD(5, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(5, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EarlyMayBankHoliday              '  4. EarlyMayBankHoliday
    If arrHD(6, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(6, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SpringBankHoliday                '  5. SpringBankHoliday
    If arrHD(7, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(7, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SummerBankHoliday                '  6. Early Summer holiday
    
    ' Substitute Bank Holiday for Boxing Day 2024 in the United Kingdom
    ' If Boxing Day falls on a Saturday, the following Monday is a substitute bank holiday.
    ' If Christmas Day falls on a Saturday, the following Monday and Tuesday are substitute bank holidays.
    ' The bank holiday is a time for many people to relax and enjoy a day off from work.
    
    If arrHD(8, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(8, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay                     '  7. Weihnachtstag
    
    If arrHD(9, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(9, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay                        '  8. Boxing Day
    
    If TradingCurrency = POUND Then
        If Weekday(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay) = vbSaturday Then
            If arrHD(10, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(10, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1          ' 10. Substituteday1
            If arrHD(11, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(12, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay2          ' 11. Substituteday2
        End If
        If Weekday(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay) = vbSaturday Then
            If arrHD(10, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(10, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1           ' 10. Substituteday1
        End If
    End If
    
    If arrHD(12, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(12, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday1                   ' 12. Customized Holiday 1
    If arrHD(13, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(13, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday2                   ' 13. Customized Holiday 2
    If arrHD(14, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(14, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday3                   ' 14. Customized Holiday 3
    If arrHD(15, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(15, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday4                   ' 15. Customized Holiday 4
    If arrHD(16, 1) = "x" Or arrCU(16, 1) = "x" Then colHoliday.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday5                   ' 16. Customized Holiday 5

    Set Holidays = colHoliday
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: IsHoliday
' Purpose: The method checks, if a given date is a holiday
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter datDate (Date): This is the date to check
' Return Type: Boolean
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 08.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function IsHoliday(TradingCurrency As String, datDate As Date) As Boolean
Dim intYear As Integer, _
    i As Integer
    
    If IsDate(datDate) Then
        intYear = Year(datDate)
    End If
        
    Set colHoliday = Holidays(TradingCurrency, intYear)
        
    IsHoliday = IIf(IsDateInCollection(colHoliday, datDate), True, False)
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: NextBizDay
' Purpose: The method delivers the next business day after a given day
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter datStartDate (Date): the day, for which we need the next business day
' Return Type: Date
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 08.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function NextBizDay(TradingCurrency As String, datStartDate As Date) As Date
Dim NextDay As Date

    LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(datStartDate)
    NextDay = datStartDate + 1
    Do While Weekday(NextDay, vbMonday) > 5 Or IsHoliday(TradingCurrency, NextDay)
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(NextDay)
        NextDay = NextDay + 1
    Loop
    ' NextDay = datStartDate
'    If IsHoliday(TradingCurrency, NextDay) Then LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(NextDay)
'    NextDay = DateAdd("d", 1, NextDay)
'    If IsHoliday(TradingCurrency, NextDay) Then LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(NextDay)
'    NextDay = DateAdd("d", 1, NextDay)
'    If IsHoliday(TradingCurrency, NextDay) Then LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(NextDay)
'    NextDay = DateAdd("d", 1, NextDay)
'    If IsHoliday(TradingCurrency, NextDay) Then LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & TheHolidayIs(NextDay)
'    NextDay = DateAdd("d", 1, NextDay)
    NextBizDay = NextDay
    Debug.Print "Ende"
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: DaysUntilNextBizDay
' Purpose: The method delivers the number of days until the next business day
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter datStartDate (Date): the start day from which we need to know the number of days until the next business day
' Return Type: Integer
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 08.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function DaysUntilNextBizDay(TradingCurrency As String, datStartDate As Date) As Integer
Dim NextDay As Date
Dim GFD As Date, _
    CHD As Date, _
    LBD As Date, _
    BOD As Date, _
    EBD As Date, _
    NBD As Date
Dim CustomersText As String
Dim CD1 As String: Dim CD2 As String
Dim Substitute As Integer
    
    NextDay = NextBizDay(TradingCurrency, datStartDate)
    
    DaysUntilNextBizDay = NextDay - datStartDate
    specialDay = False
    
    ' Easter
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Easter") > 0 Then
        GFD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).GoodFriday
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & datStartDate & ", then " & "<BR>" & GFD & " is Good Friday," & "<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & DateAdd("d", 1, GFD) & " is a Saturday, " & "<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & DateAdd("d", 2, GFD) & " is Easter Sunday, " & "<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & DateAdd("d", 3, GFD) & " is Easter Monday, and finally " & "<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & DateAdd("d", 4, GFD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' Christmas & Boxing Day
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Christmas") > 0 Or InStr(LRDayDescription, "Boxing") > 0 Then
        CHD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).ChristmasDay
        BOD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).BoxingDay
        CD1 = IIf(TradingCurrency = POUND, "Christmas", "the first christmas day")
        CD2 = IIf(TradingCurrency = POUND, "Boxing Day", "the second christmas day")
        
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is Christmas Eve <BR>" & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ", then <BR>" & _
                           GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(CHD) & ", the " & CHD & " is <BR>" & CD1 & ",<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(BOD) & ", the " & BOD & " is <BR>" & CD2 & ", <BR>"
        Substitute = 0
        If Weekday(BOD) = vbSaturday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, BOD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, BOD) & " is weekend and <BR>"
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1 + 1, BOD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1 + 1, BOD) & " is Substitution day<BR>"
            Substitute = 2
        End If
        If Weekday(BOD) = vbSunday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, BOD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, BOD) & " is weekend,<BR>"
            Substitute = 1
        End If
        If Weekday(BOD) = vbFriday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, BOD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, BOD) & " and <BR>Sunday, the " & DateAdd("d", 2, BOD) & " are weekend,<BR>"
            Substitute = 2
        End If
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, BOD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, BOD) & " is the next business day"
        Debug.Print LRDayDescription
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' Labour day
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Labour") > 0 Then
        LBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).labourDay
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & datStartDate & ", therefore " & "<BR>" & LBD & " is labour day and" & "<BR>"
        Dim ShiftDays As Integer
        Select Case Weekday(LBD)
            Case vbFriday: ShiftDays = 3
            Case vbSaturday: ShiftDays = 2
            Case Else: ShiftDays = 1
        End Select
        If TradingCurrency = POUND And Weekday(LBD) = vbMonday Then ShiftDays = ShiftDays + 1
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & DateAdd("d", ShiftDays, LBD) & " is then the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    
    ' Early Bank holiday
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Early") > 0 And TradingCurrency = POUND Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).EarlyMayBankHoliday
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then Monday, the " & EBD & " is the <BR>Early May BankHoliday," & "<BR>"
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & "BUT because ECC's first limit is started at " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(EBD) & ", the " & EBD & " is also the next business day"
            DaysUntilNextBizDay = DaysUntilNextBizDay - 1
        Else
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        End If
        
        ' --- new since 20250502
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            NBD = DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)
            LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & datStartDate & ", the next UK business day is Tuesday, the " & NBD & ", as Monday is a UK holiday only, ECC will provide limit updates on Monday, the " & EBD
            Debug.Print LRDayDescription
        End If
        ' ---
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    
    ' Spring Bank holiday
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Spring") > 0 And TradingCurrency = POUND Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).SpringBankHoliday
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ", then <BR> " & _
                           "Monday, " & EBD & " is the Spring BankHoliday" & "<BR>"
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & "BUT because ECC's first limit is started at " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(EBD) & ", the " & EBD & " is also the next business day"
            DaysUntilNextBizDay = DaysUntilNextBizDay - 1
        Else
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        End If
        
        ' --- new since 20250502
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            NBD = DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)
            LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & datStartDate & ", the next UK business day is Tuesday, the " & NBD & ", as Monday is a UK holiday only, ECC will provide limit updates on Monday, the " & EBD
            Debug.Print LRDayDescription
        End If
        ' ---
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' Summer Bank Holiday
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Summer") > 0 And TradingCurrency = POUND Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).SummerBankHoliday
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ", then <BR> " & _
                           "Monday, " & EBD & " is the Summer BankHoliday" & "<BR>"
        
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & "BUT because ECC's first limit is started at " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(EBD) & ", the " & EBD & " is also the next business day"
            DaysUntilNextBizDay = DaysUntilNextBizDay - 1
        Else
            LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1 + Substitute, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        End If
        
        ' --- new since 20250502
        If Weekday(EBD) = vbMonday Then
            NBD = DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)
            LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & datStartDate & ", the next UK business day is Tuesday, the " & NBD & ", as Monday is a UK holiday only, ECC will provide limit updates on Monday, the " & EBD
            Debug.Print LRDayDescription
        End If
        ' ---
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' customized Holiday 1
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Customer specific holiday 1") > 0 Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday1
        CustomersText = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday1Name
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then " & EBD & " is the customized holiday (" & CustomersText & ")<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' customized Holiday 2
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Customer specific holiday 2") > 0 Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday2
        CustomersText = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday2Name
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then " & EBD & " is the customized holiday (" & CustomersText & ")<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' customized Holiday 3
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Customer specific holiday 3") > 0 Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday3
        CustomersText = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday3Name
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then " & EBD & " is the customized holiday (" & CustomersText & ")<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' customized Holiday 4
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Customer specific holiday 4") > 0 Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday4
        CustomersText = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday4Name
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then " & EBD & " is the customized holiday (" & CustomersText & ")<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    ' customized Holiday 5
    If InStr(LRDayDescription, "Customer specific holiday 5") > 0 Then
        EBD = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday5
        CustomersText = HolidayDateDict.item(Year(datStartDate)).CustHoliday5Name
        LRDayDescription = "Start date is " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(datStartDate) & ", the  " & datStartDate & ",<BR>" & _
                           "then " & EBD & " is the customized holiday (" & CustomersText & ")<BR>"
        LRDayDescription = LRDayDescription & " and finally " & GetTheEnglishWeekdayName(DateAdd("d", 1, EBD)) & ", the " & DateAdd("d", 1, EBD) & " is the next business day"
        specialDay = True
    End If
    
    If Not specialDay Then
        Select Case Weekday(frmMain.txtDate.value)
            Case vbFriday
                LRDayDescription = "The trading day is a Friday, therefore the next business day will be Monday - in 3 days"
            Case vbSaturday
                LRDayDescription = "The trading day is a Saturday, therefore the next business day will be Monday - in 2 days"
            Case vbSunday
                LRDayDescription = "The trading day is a Sunday, therefore the next business day will be Monday - in 1 day"
        End Select
    End If
        
End Function

Function Bußtag(intYear As Integer)
Dim Christmas As Long

    '© 01.01.96 Edi Bauer, Zwiesel
    Christmas = DateSerial(intYear, 12, 24)
    Bußtag = Christmas - Weekday(Christmas) - 31

End Function

Public Function GetEarlyMayBankHoliday(intYear As Integer) As Date
    
   GetEarlyMayBankHoliday = FirstMonday(5, intYear)
   
End Function

Public Function GetSpringBankHoliday(intYear As Integer) As Date
    
    GetSpringBankHoliday = LastMonday(5, intYear)
   
End Function

Public Function GetSummerBankHoliday(intYear As Integer) As Date
    
    GetSummerBankHoliday = LastMonday(8, intYear)
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: FirstMondayAfterChristmas
' Purpose: The method delivers the date of the first Monday after Christmas
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter TheYear (Integer): The appropriate year, for which we need the first Monday after Christmas
' Return Type: Date
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 08.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function FirstMondayAfterChristmas(intYear As Integer) As Date
Dim Christmas As Date, _
    FirstMonday As Date

    ' Christmas is always at 25. December
    Christmas = DateSerial(intYear, 12, 25)
    
    ' find the next Monday after Christmas
    FirstMonday = Christmas + 1
    Do While Weekday(FirstMonday) <> 2 ' 2 monday corresponds to 2
        FirstMonday = FirstMonday + 1
    Loop
    
    FirstMondayAfterChristmas = FirstMonday
    
End Function

    With frmConfig
        For CtrlNb = 1 To FederalStateDict.Count

        Next CtrlNb
    End With
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetHolidaysInfos-
' Purpose: The procedure reads data from the calendar sheet related of properties
'          of holidays into the appropriate dictionary HolidayPropertyDict
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 23.05.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub GetHolidaysInfos()
Dim arrCalendars
Dim intCalendarLine As Integer
Dim clsHDays As clsHolidaysPerCalendar
    
    Set clsHDays = New clsHolidaysPerCalendar
    HolidayPropertyDict.RemoveAll
    arrCalendars = ShtHolidays.Range("AllCalendars")
    For intCalendarLine = 1 To UBound(arrCalendars)
        With clsHDays
            .HNameEN = arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 1)
            .HNameDE = arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 2)
            .HowToCalc = arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 3)
            .HActive = arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 4)
            .H_T2 = IIf(arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 5) = "x", True, False)
            .H_GB = IIf(arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 6) = "x", True, False)
            .H_CU = IIf(arrCalendars(intCalendarLine, 7) = "x", True, False)
            
            .HDate = INITDATE
        End With
        HolidayPropertyDict.Add clsHDays.HNameEN, clsHDays
        Set clsHDays = New clsHolidaysPerCalendar
    Next intCalendarLine
    
End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: FirstMonday
' Purpose: The function delivers te first Monday of the appropriate month and year
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter ThisMonth (Integer): The appropriate Month
' Parameter ThisYear (Integer): The appropriate Year
' Return Type: Date
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 06.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function FirstMonday(ThisMonth As Integer, ThisYear As Integer) As Date
Dim ThisDate As Date
    
    ThisDate = DateSerial(ThisYear, ThisMonth, 1)
    If Weekday(ThisDate) = vbMonday Then
        FirstMonday = ThisDate
    Else
        FirstMonday = ThisDate + (vbMonday - Weekday(ThisDate) + 7) Mod 7
    End If
    
End Function
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: lastMonday
' Purpose: The function delivers te last Monday of the appropriate month and year
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter ThisMonth (Integer): The appropriate Month
' Parameter ThisYear (Integer): The appropriate Year
' Return Type: Date
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 06.06.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function LastMonday(ThisMonth As Integer, ThisYear As Integer) As Date
Dim TheLastDay As Date
Dim TheWeekDay As Integer

    ' Get the last day of the month
    TheLastDay = DateSerial(ThisYear, ThisMonth + 1, 0)
    
    ' Get the weekday of the last day of the month
    TheWeekDay = Weekday(TheLastDay)
    
    ' Calculate the date of the last monday
    LastMonday = TheLastDay - ((TheWeekDay + 5) Mod 7)
    
End Function

Sub HolidayActivator(FederalState As String)
Dim strHDNb As String
Dim HolidayNb As Integer

    If FederalState <> vbNullString Then
        EmptyHolidayDates
        
        With frmConfig
            For HolidayNb = 1 To MAXHOLIDAYS
                strHDNb = Format(HolidayNb, "00")
                If .Controls("lbl" & FederalState & strHDNb).Picture.Handle <> 0 Then
                    .Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value = True
                Else
                    .Controls("chkActive" & strHDNb).value = False
                End If
            Next HolidayNb
            .cboCEFederalState.value = FederalStateDict.item(FederalState).cboText
            ShtHolidays.Range("SelectedCalendar") = FederalStateDict.item(FederalState).cboText
            
            Call ShowAllHolidays(.cboCEYear.value)
        End With
    End If
        
End Sub

Sub ShowAllHolidays(intYear As Integer)
    
    With HolidayDateDict.item(intYear)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuNewYearsDay, .NewYearsDay)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuGoodFriday, .GoodFriday)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuEasterMonday, .EasterMonday)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuLabourDay, .labourDay)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuEarlyMayBankHoliday, .EarlyMayBankHoliday)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuSpringBankHoliday, .SpringBankHoliday)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuSummerBankHoliday, .SummerBankHoliday)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuChristmasDay, .ChristmasDay)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuBoxingDay, .BoxingDay)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuCustomizedDay1, .CustHoliday1)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuCustomizedDay2, .CustHoliday2)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuCustomizedDay3, .CustHoliday3)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuCustomizedDay4, .CustHoliday4)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuCustomizedDay5, .CustHoliday5)
        Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuBoxingDay, .BoxingDay)
        If frmConfig.cboCECurrency.value = POUND Then
            If Weekday(.BoxingDay) = vbSaturday Then
                Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuSubstitute1Day, .SubstituteDay1)
            End If
            If Weekday(.ChristmasDay) = vbSaturday Then
                Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuSubstitute1Day, .SubstituteDay1)
                Call HolidayActivityTextHandler(enuSubstitute2Day, .SubstituteDay2)
            End If
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub


Public Sub HolidayActivityTextHandler(strCtrlNb As String, DictItem As String)
Dim tmpControlName As String
Dim blnResult As Boolean

    strCtrlNb = Format(strCtrlNb, "00")
    blnResult = False
    With frmConfig
        
        If .Controls("chkActive" & strCtrlNb).value Then
             .Controls("txtCE" & strCtrlNb).Visible = True
            .Controls("txtCE" & strCtrlNb).value = IIf(strCtrlNb < CInt(MAXSTDHDAY), DictItem, .Controls("txtHowToCalc" & strCtrlNb).value)
            tmpControlName = .Controls(IIf(CTDE, "txtGerman", "txtEnglish") & strCtrlNb).value
            
            .Controls("lblCE" & strCtrlNb).Visible = True
            .Controls("lblCE" & strCtrlNb).Caption = tmpControlName
            
            blnResult = True
        Else
            .Controls("txtCE" & strCtrlNb).Visible = False
            .Controls("lblCE" & strCtrlNb).Visible = False
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: CheckDate4BusinessDate
' Purpose: The method checks, if a given date is a business date
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Parameter Date2Check (Date): the date to check
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 23.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub CheckDate4BusinessDate(Date2Check As Date)
Dim theColor As String

    If Not AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(Date2Check) Then
        frmMain.txtDate.BackColor = vbRed
        theColor = "vbRed"
        MsgBox "This date is not a business day please choose another one!", vbExclamation, "Selected date: " & Format(Date2Check, Fmt.LocalFormat)
    Else
        frmMain.txtDate.BackColor = vbWhite
        theColor = "vbWhite"
    End If
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: ShowSubstitueDaysForGB
' Purpose: In case the user has selected GBP in the configuration page for calendars,
'          then the method shows or hides the inout textboxes for the substitute days
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 10.07.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub ShowSubstitueDaysForGB()
Dim ShowIt As Boolean
    
    With frmConfig
        .txtCE09.Visible = False   ' as default, nothing is visible
        .txtCE10.Visible = False
        .lblCE09.Visible = False
        .lblCE10.Visible = False
        
        ShowIt = IIf(.cboCECurrency.value = POUND, True, False)  ' check, if the trading currency is GBP
        
        Select Case frmConfig.cboCEYear.value
            Case 2027, 2032, 2038, 2049                          ' In these years, both substitution days are to consider
                .txtCE09.Visible = ShowIt
                .txtCE10.Visible = ShowIt
                .lblCE09.Visible = ShowIt
                .lblCE10.Visible = ShowIt
            Case 2033, 2039, 2044                                ' In these years, only the first substitution day is to consider
                .txtCE09.Visible = ShowIt
                .lblCE09.Visible = ShowIt
            Case 2028, 2037, 2043, 2048                          ' In these years, only the last substitution day is to consider
                .txtCE10.Visible = ShowIt
                .lblCE10.Visible = ShowIt
        End Select
    End With
        
End Sub

Dim Date2Check As Date
    
    Date2Check = DateSerial(SelectedYear, 12, 31)
    IsECCCalendarComplete = AllBusinessDaysDict.Exists(Date2Check)
    
End Function

Public Sub PutGBHolidaysIntoRange(intYear As Integer)
Dim arrHDGB As Variant, _
    TableItem As Variant, _
    WriteArray() As Variant, _
    arrHD As Variant
Dim LastLine As Integer, _
    HDNb As Integer

    LastLine = ShtHolidays.Range("D" & ShtHolidays.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    arrHDGB = ShtHolidays.Range("D4:D" & CStr(LastLine))
    
    ReDim arrHD(1 To MAXHOLIDAYS)
    arrHD = ShtHolidays.Range(HCOL_GB & "4:" & HCOL_GB & CStr(LastLine))
    
    GBHolidayDict.RemoveAll
    For Each TableItem In arrHDGB
        If Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(TableItem) Then
            GBHolidayDict.Add TableItem, Null
        End If
    Next TableItem
    
    If arrHD(1, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).NewYearsDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).NewYearsDay, Null
    If arrHD(2, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).GoodFriday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).GoodFriday, Null
    If arrHD(3, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EasterMonday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EasterMonday, Null
    If arrHD(4, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).labourDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).labourDay, Null
    If arrHD(5, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EarlyMayBankHoliday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).EarlyMayBankHoliday, Null
    If arrHD(6, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SpringBankHoliday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SpringBankHoliday, Null
    If arrHD(7, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SummerBankHoliday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SummerBankHoliday, Null
    If arrHD(8, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay, Null
    If arrHD(9, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay, Null
    If arrHD(10, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1, Null
    If arrHD(11, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay2) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay2, Null
    
    If arrHD(12, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday1) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday1, Null
    If arrHD(13, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday2) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday2, Null
    If arrHD(14, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday3) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday3, Null
    If arrHD(15, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday4) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday4, Null
    If arrHD(16, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday5) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday5, Null
    
    ReDim arrBDT2(0 To T2HolidayDict.Count) As Variant
    HDNb = 0
    For Each TableItem In T2HolidayDict.Keys()
        arrBDT2(HDNb) = TableItem
       HDNb = HDNb + 1
    Next TableItem
    
    WriteArray = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(arrBDT2)
    ShtCalendar.Range("D4:D" & CStr(HDNb + 4)) = WriteArray
    
    LastLine = ShtCalendar.Range("D" & ShtCalendar.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    For HDNb = 4 To LastLine
            ShtCalendar.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).value = CDate(ShtCalendar.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).value)
            ShtCalendar.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).NumberFormat = "m/d/yyyy"
    Next HDNb
    
End Sub

    If arrT2(7, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SummerBankHoliday) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SummerBankHoliday, Null
    If arrT2(8, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).ChristmasDay, Null
    If arrT2(9, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).BoxingDay, Null
    If arrT2(10, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay1, Null
    If arrT2(11, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay2) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).SubstituteDay2, Null
    
    If arrT2(12, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday1) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday1, Null
    If arrT2(13, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday2) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday2, Null
    If arrT2(14, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday3) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday3, Null
    If arrT2(15, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday4) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday4, Null
    If arrT2(16, 1) = "x" And Not GBHolidayDict.Exists(HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday5) Then GBHolidayDict.Add HolidayDateDict.item(intYear).CustHoliday5, Null
    
    
    ReDim arrBDT2(0 To GBHolidayDict.Count) As Variant
    HDNb = 0
    For Each TableItem In GBHolidayDict.Keys()
        arrBDT2(HDNb) = TableItem
       HDNb = HDNb + 1
    Next TableItem
    
    WriteArray = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(arrBDT2)
    ShtHolidays.Range("D4:D" & CStr(HDNb + 4)) = WriteArray
    
    LastLine = ShtHolidays.Range("D" & ShtHolidays.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    For HDNb = 4 To LastLine
            ShtHolidays.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).value = CDate(ShtHolidays.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).value)
            ShtHolidays.Range("D" & CStr(HDNb)).NumberFormat = "m/d/yyyy"
    Next HDNb
        
End Sub

Public Sub RecreateECCCalendar()
Dim NewDate As Date, _
    LastOldDate As Date, _
    NewYearDay As Date, _
    GoodFriday As Date, _
    EasterMonday As Date, _
    labourDay As Date, _
    ChristmasDay As Date, _
    BoxingDay As Date
Dim LastLine As Integer, _
    NewLine As Integer, _
    DayNb As Integer, _
    NewYear As Integer, _
    CalcYear As Integer, _
    NextYear As Integer, _
    NumberDaysInThisYear As Integer, _
    CustHDNb As Integer
    
    LastLine = ShtCalendar.Range("A" & ShtCalendar.Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    ShtCalendar.Range("A2:A" & CStr(LastLine)).Clear
    NewLine = 2
    NewYear = 2023
    LastOldDate = CDate(DateSerial(2022, 12, 31))
    
    NextYear = Year(Now) + 2
    
    For CalcYear = NewYear To NextYear
    
        NewYearDay = DateSerial(CalcYear, 1, 1)
        GoodFriday = DateAdd("d", -2, EasterSunday(CalcYear))
        EasterMonday = DateAdd("d", 1, EasterSunday(CalcYear))
        labourDay = DateSerial(CalcYear, 5, 1)
        ChristmasDay = DateSerial(CalcYear, 12, 25)
        BoxingDay = DateSerial(CalcYear, 12, 26)
                
        ' Check if the year is a leap year (Schaltjahr)
        NumberDaysInThisYear = IIf(IsLeapYear(CalcYear), 366, 365)
        
        For DayNb = 1 To NumberDaysInThisYear
            NewDate = DateAdd("d", DayNb, LastOldDate)
            If Weekday(NewDate) <> vbSaturday And _
                Weekday(NewDate) <> vbSunday And _
                NewDate <> NewYearDay And _
                NewDate <> GoodFriday And _
                NewDate <> labourDay And _
                NewDate <> EasterMonday And _
                NewDate <> ChristmasDay And _
                NewDate <> BoxingDay Then
                
                For CustHDNb = MAXSTDHDAY To MAXHOLIDAYS
                    If frmConfig.Controls("chkActive" & CStr(CustHDNb)).value = True And _
                        frmConfig.Controls("txtHowToCalc" & CStr(CustHDNb)).value = NewDate And _
                        frmConfig.cboCEFederalState.value = FederalStates(0) Then
                        GoTo DayAddJump
                    End If
                Next CustHDNb
                
                With ShtCalendar
                    .Range("A" & CStr(NewLine)).value = NewDate
                    .Range("A" & CStr(NewLine)).NumberFormat = Fmt.LocalFormat
                End With
                
                NewLine = NewLine + 1
            End If
DayAddJump:
        Next DayNb
        LastOldDate = NewDate
    Next CalcYear
    
    
'   Find last row of data in column A
    LastLine = LastRowOfColumn(ShtCalendar, 1)
    
    With ShtCalendar
        On Error Resume Next
        .Names("Input_StartDataCalendars").Delete
        ' .Range(.Range("A1"), .Range("A" & LastLine).End(xlUp)).Name = "Input_StartDataCalendars"
        .Range("A1:A" & LastLine).Name = "Input_StartDataCalendars"
    End With
    
    ReadAllECCBusinessdays
    
    frmConfig.cmdCEAddECCCalendar.Visible = IIf(IsECCCalendarComplete(frmConfig.cboCEYear.value), False, True)
        
End Sub

Function ReplaceSeparator(DateField As String) As Date
    
    If LocalSeparator = "/" Then
        If InStr(ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value, ".") > 0 Then
            ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value = Replace(ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value, ".", LocalSeparator)
        End If
    ElseIf LocalSeparator = "." Then
        If InStr(ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value, "/") > 0 Then
            ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value = Replace(ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value, "/", LocalSeparator)
        End If
    End If
    ReplaceSeparator = CDate(ShtHolidays.Range(DateField).value)
    
End Function

Private Const GWL_STYLE As Long = (-16)
Private Const WS_THICKFRAME As Long = &H40000
Private Const WS_SYSMENU As Long = &H80000
Private Const WS_MINIMIZEBOX As Long = &H20000
Private Const WS_MAXIMIZEBOX As Long = &H10000
Private Const SW_SHOW As Long = 5

Private m_objUserForm   As Object
Private m_hWndForm      As Long
Private Sub Class_Terminate()
  Set m_objUserForm = Nothing
End Sub
Public Property Set Form(ByVal objForm As Object)
    Dim nStyle As Long
    
    Set m_objUserForm = objForm
    m_hWndForm = FindWindow(vbNullString, m_objUserForm.Caption)
    If m_hWndForm <> 0 Then
        nStyle = GetWindowLong(m_hWndForm, GWL_STYLE)
        nStyle = nStyle Or WS_THICKFRAME Or WS_SYSMENU Or _
            WS_MINIMIZEBOX Or WS_MAXIMIZEBOX
        SetWindowLong m_hWndForm, GWL_STYLE, nStyle
        ShowWindow m_hWndForm, SW_SHOW
        DrawMenuBar m_hWndForm
        SetFocus m_hWndForm
    End If
End Property
Public Property Get gIsIconic() As Boolean
    If m_hWndForm <> 0 Then
        gIsIconic = CBool(IsIconic(m_hWndForm))
    End If
End Property
Public Property Get gIsZoomed() As Boolean
    If m_hWndForm <> 0 Then
        gIsZoomed = CBool(IsZoomed(m_hWndForm))
    End If
End Property

VBA MACRO Markets.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/Markets'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Option Private Module

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: FillMarketsIntoComboboxes
' Purpose: The sub fills the comboboxes with the available markets from the sheet markets
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 19.04.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub FillMarketsIntoComboboxes(UpdateCurrentValue As Boolean)
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim lZeile  As Long
Dim tmpMarketStoreDict As New Scripting.Dictionary
Dim MDValues As clsMarketData

    tmpMarketStoreDict.RemoveAll
    Set MDValues = New clsMarketData
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        With frmMain
            MDValues.Market = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
            MDValues.Ccy = .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
            MDValues.BDA = .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
            MDValues.NBDA = .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
            MDValues.Dist = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
            tmpMarketStoreDict.Add MarketNb, MDValues
            Set MDValues = New clsMarketData
            frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).Clear
        End With
    Next MarketNb
    
    With ShtMarkets
        For lZeile = 4 To .Range("B65536").End(xlUp).Row
            If .Range("B" & lZeile).value <> vbNullString Then
                For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
                    frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).AddItem .Range("B" & lZeile).value
                Next MarketNb
            End If
        Next lZeile
    End With
    
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        With frmMain
            If UpdateCurrentValue Then
                If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).ListCount > 0 Then
                    .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).ListIndex = 0
                End If
            Else
                .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).Market
                .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).Ccy
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).BDA
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).NBDA
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).Dist
                If tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).BDA <> vbNullString Then .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                If tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).NBDA <> vbNullString Then .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                If tmpMarketStoreDict.item(MarketNb).Dist <> vbNullString Then .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
            End If
        End With
    Next MarketNb
    
End Sub

Public Sub DeleteMarket(MarketNb2Delete As Integer)
Dim tmpMarket As String, _
    tmpCurrency As String, _
    tmpBDA As String, _
    tmpNBDA As String, _
    tmpDist As String
Dim MarketNb As Integer

    With frmMain
        .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb2Delete)).value = vbNullString
        .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb2Delete)).Locked = True
        .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb2Delete)).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
        .Controls("txtDist_0" & CInt(MarketNb2Delete)).BackColor = vbWhite
    
        For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS - 1
            If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = vbNullString Then
            
                ' buffer the content of the cells
                tmpMarket = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value      ' store the next market into a temporary variable
                tmpCurrency = .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value
                tmpBDA = .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value
                tmpNBDA = .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value
                tmpDist = .Controls("txtDist_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value
                
                .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value = vbNullString   ' make the next market empty to avoid duplicate martkets
                .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = tmpMarket          ' take the current market from the temporary variabel
                
                .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = tmpCurrency
                
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = tmpBDA
                
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = tmpNBDA
                
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = tmpDist
                
            End If
        Next MarketNb
        For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
            If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).value = vbNullString Then
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
            Else
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).Locked = .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).Locked
                .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb)).Picture = .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CInt(MarketNb + 1)).Picture
            End If
            
        Next MarketNb
    End With
    
    CopyFormValuesIntoSheet
    EnableStartButton
        
End Sub

Public Sub CheckForValidSpecialMarkets(ItemNb As Integer)
Dim Market2check As String
Dim TradeDate2Check As Date
Dim MarketColumn As Integer, _
    LastRow As Integer, _
    LastColumn As Integer
Dim MarketName As Variant, _
    TradingDate As Variant
Dim MarketTradingDateFound As Boolean

    If Not StartUpProcess Then
        With frmMain
            Market2check = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value
            LastColumn = ShtCalendar.Cells(3, ShtCalendar.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
            arrSpecialMarkets = GetSpecMarkets
            If IsInArray(Market2check, arrSpecialMarkets) Then
                'TradeDate2Check = CDate(.txtDate.Value)
                TradeDate2Check = DateAdd("d", 1, CDate(.txtDate.value))
                MarketTradingDateFound = False
                For Each MarketName In ShtCalendar.Range(ShtCalendar.Cells(3, 7), ShtCalendar.Cells(3, LastColumn))
                    If MarketName.value = Market2check Then
                        MarketColumn = MarketName.Column
                        LastRow = ShtCalendar.Cells(ShtCalendar.Rows.Count, MarketColumn).End(xlUp).Row
                        For Each TradingDate In ShtCalendar.Range(ShtCalendar.Cells(4, MarketColumn), ShtCalendar.Cells(LastRow, MarketColumn))
                            If TradingDate.value = TradeDate2Check Then MarketTradingDateFound = True
                        Next TradingDate
                    End If
                Next MarketName
                If Not MarketTradingDateFound Then
                    .txtDate.BackColor = vbYellow
                    .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).BackColor = vbYellow
                    MsgBox "For Market " & Market2check & " no trading date at " & .txtDate.value & " is configured!" & vbCrLf & _
                        "Please check the market, the trading date or the trading date in the configuraion!", vbExclamation, "No trading date found!"
                    .txtDate.BackColor = vbWhite
                    .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                End If
            End If
        End With
    End If
        
End Sub


Public Sub SetMarkets(ItemNb As Integer)
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim BasketInactive As Boolean

    Call CheckForValidSpecialMarkets(ItemNb)
    If Not StartUpProcess Then
        If Not ShowMarketUsage Then Exit Sub
    End If
    BasketInactive = False
    With frmMain
        If Not StartUpProcess Then
            For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
                If MarketNb <> ItemNb Then
                    If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value <> vbNullString Then
                        If .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value Then
                            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).BackColor = vbRed
                            MsgBox "This market is already considered, Please choose another one!", vbExclamation, "Duplicate market!"
                            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).BackColor = vbWhite
                            .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = vbNullString
                            .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).Picture = .btnBasketInactive.Picture
                            BasketInactive = True
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next MarketNb
            .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).Locked = False
        End If
    ' String is in range
        
        ' .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).Value = Right(.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).Value, 3)
        .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = MarketCcyDict.item(.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value)
        If Not StartUpProcess Then
            ShtStart.Range("Market_0" & CStr(ItemNb)) = .Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value
            If .Controls("cboCurrency_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = vbNullString Then
                .Controls("txtBDA_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("txtNBDA_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = vbNullString
                .Controls("txtDist_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).value = vbNullString
            End If
            If Not BasketInactive Then .Controls("btnBasket_0" & CStr(ItemNb)).Picture = .btnBasketActive.Picture
        End If
    End With
        
End Sub

    LastRow = ShtMarkets.Cells(ActiveSheet.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row

    End With

End Sub

Public Function GetMarketsFromList(MarketCorrection As Boolean) As Integer
Dim MarketNb As Integer
Dim OutMarket As String
    
    With frmConfig
        If Not MarketCorrection Then
            If .lstMarkets.ListIndex > -1 And .lstMarkets.Selected(.lstMarkets.ListIndex) Then
                .txtConfMarket.value = .lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 1)
                .cboConfLimitReset.value = .lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 2)
                .cboConfBDforExposure.value = .lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 3)
                
                blnConfAuctionFlag = IIf(.lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 4) = 1, True, False)
                Call SetFlagTrigger(.lblConfAuctionOnOff, blnConfAuctionFlag)
                
                .cboConfCurrency.value = .lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 5)
                .cboConfBDCalendar.value = .lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 6)
                
                blnConfSepTDCalendar = IIf(.lstMarkets.List(.lstMarkets.ListIndex, 7) = 1, True, False)
                frmConfig.cmdMarketDetails.Visible = blnConfSepTDCalendar
                Call SetFlagTrigger(.lblConfSepTDCalendarOnOff, blnConfSepTDCalendar)
                
                .imgConfMarketIsNOTUsed.Visible = True
                .imgConfMarketIsNOTUsed.Left = 380
                For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
                    OutMarket = frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
                    If OutMarket = .txtConfMarket.value Then
                        .imgConfMarketIsUsed.Visible = True
                        .imgConfMarketIsUsed.Left = 380
                        .imgConfMarketIsNOTUsed.Visible = False
                        .imgConfMarketIsNOTUsed.Left = 1000
                    End If
                Next MarketNb
                GetMarketsFromList = .lstMarkets.ListIndex + 4
            End If
        End If
    End With
    
End Function

Private Function FillMarketDictionaries(MC As String, MarketControl As String, LastRow As Integer) As Dictionary
Dim arrMarketTableItems, _
    TableItem As Variant
Dim LocalDict As New Scripting.Dictionary
    
    arrMarketTableItems = ShtMarkets.Range(MC & "4:" & MC & CStr(LastRow))
    LocalDict.RemoveAll
    frmConfig.Controls(MarketControl).Clear
    For Each TableItem In arrMarketTableItems
        If Not LocalDict.Exists(TableItem) Then
            LocalDict.Add TableItem, Null
            frmConfig.Controls(MarketControl).AddItem TableItem
        End If
    Next TableItem
    
    Set FillMarketDictionaries = LocalDict
    
End Function

Private Function FillMarketLimitResetDict(LastRow As Integer) As Dictionary
Dim arrMarketTableItems, _
    TableItem As Variant
Dim ItemNb As Integer

    arrMarketTableItems = ShtMarkets.Range("B4:C" & CStr(LastRow))
    MarketLimitResetDict.RemoveAll
    Debug.Print UBound(arrMarketTableItems)
    For ItemNb = 1 To UBound(arrMarketTableItems)
        If Not MarketLimitResetDict.Exists(arrMarketTableItems(ItemNb, 1)) Then
            MarketLimitResetDict.Add arrMarketTableItems(ItemNb, 1), arrMarketTableItems(ItemNb, 2)
        End If
    Next ItemNb
    
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: SetSpecMarketsPosition
' Purpose: Filling Dictionary with position of special markets in the sheet markets
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 25.11.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub SetSpecMarketsPosition()
Dim SpecMarket As String
Dim LastColumn As Integer, _
    NbSpecMarket As Integer, _
    NbSpecMarkets As Integer
    
    ' LastColumn = ShtMarkets.Cells(ActiveSheet.Columns.Count, 4).End(xlUp).Column
    LastColumn = ShtCalendar.Cells(3, ShtCalendar.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    NbSpecMarkets = 0
    SpecMarketColumnsDict.RemoveAll
    For NbSpecMarket = 7 To LastColumn
        SpecMarket = ShtCalendar.Cells(3, NbSpecMarket)
        If Not SpecMarketColumnsDict.Exists(SpecMarket) Then

            NbSpecMarkets = NbSpecMarkets + 1
        End If
    Next NbSpecMarket
    
End Sub

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: GetMarketsCurrency
' Purpose: The method writes the markets together with the appropriate currency into a dictionar
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 13.09.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub GetMarketsCurrency()
Dim MarketNb As Integer, _
    LastLine As Integer

    MarketCcyDict.RemoveAll
    With ShtMarkets
        LastLine = .Range("B" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
        MarketInOutputDict.RemoveAll
        For MarketNb = 4 To LastLine
            MarketCcyDict.Add .Range("B" & CStr(MarketNb)).value, .Range("F" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
        Next MarketNb
    End With
    
End Sub

Public Sub MarketSort()
    ShtMarkets.Select
    Range("A4:H22").Select
    ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("markets").Sort.SortFields.Clear
    ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("markets").Sort.SortFields.Add2 key:=Range("B4:B22" _
        ), SortOn:=xlSortOnValues, Order:=xlAscending, DataOption:=xlSortNormal
    With ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("markets").Sort
        .SetRange Range("A3:H22")
        .Header = xlYes
        .MatchCase = False
        .Orientation = xlTopToBottom
        .SortMethod = xlPinYin
        .Apply
    End With
End Sub


' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: ShowMarketUsage
' Purpose: The sub change the flag (1st column) of the market sheet
'          depends if the market is used in the market data panel or not
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 25.09.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function ShowMarketUsage() As Boolean
Dim Market As String
Dim FlagNb As Byte, _
    MarketNb As Byte, _
    LastUsageNb As Byte

    ShowMarketUsage = True
    MarketInUseDict.RemoveAll
    For MarketNb = 1 To MAXMARKETS
        Market = frmMain.Controls("cboMarket_0" & CStr(MarketNb)).value
        Debug.Print "1: " & frmMain.cboMarket_01.value
        Debug.Print "2: " & frmMain.cboMarket_02.value
        Debug.Print "3: " & frmMain.cboMarket_03.value
        Debug.Print "4: " & frmMain.cboMarket_04.value
        Debug.Print "5: " & frmMain.cboMarket_05.value
        Debug.Print "6: " & frmMain.cboMarket_06.value
        Debug.Print "7: " & frmMain.cboMarket_07.value
        Debug.Print "8: " & frmMain.cboMarket_08.value
        
        If Market <> vbNullString Then
            If Not MarketInUseDict.Exists(Market) Then
                MarketInUseDict.Add Market, Null
            Else
                MsgBox "This market is already in use, please select another one!", vbExclamation
                ShowMarketUsage = False
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next MarketNb
    
    For FlagNb = 4 To 22
        If ShtMarkets.Cells(FlagNb, 2).Value2 <> vbNullString Then
            ShtMarkets.Cells(FlagNb, 1) = IIf(MarketInUseDict.Exists(ShtMarkets.Cells(FlagNb, 2).Value2), 1, 0)
            LastUsageNb = FlagNb
        Else
            ShtMarkets.Cells(FlagNb, 1) = vbNullString
        End If
    Next FlagNb
    ShtMarkets.Cells(LastUsageNb + 1, 1) = 0

End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure Name: SelectFirstEmptyEntry
' Purpose: The Method selects the first empty entry of the listbox lstmarkets
' Procedure Kind: Sub
' Procedure Access: Public
' Author: Ingmar Pfeiffer
' Date: 25.09.2024
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Public Sub SelectFirstEmptyEntry()
Dim i As Long, _
    j As Long, _
    FlagNb As Byte
Dim foundEmpty As Boolean
        
    With frmConfig.lstMarkets
        foundEmpty = False
        ' Scroll through all entries in the ListBox
        For i = 0 To .ListCount - 1
            ' Check each column of the entry
            For j = 0 To .ColumnCount - 1
                If .List(i, j) = vbNullString Then
                    ' If an empty entry is found, select it and end the loop
                    .ListIndex = i
                    foundEmpty = True
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
            If foundEmpty Then Exit For
        Next i
        ' If no empty entry was found, show a message
        If Not foundEmpty Then
            MsgBox "Kein leerer Eintrag gefunden"
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

VBA MACRO VersionCheck.bas 
in file: xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/VersionCheck'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Option Explicit
Option Private Module

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure : XMLHttp_DownloadFile
' Author    : Daniel Pineault, CARDA Consultants Inc.
' Website   : http://www.cardaconsultants.com
' Purpose   : Download a file from the Internet locally
' Copyright : The following is release as Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
'             (CC BY-SA 4.0) - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
' Req'd Refs: Late Binding  -> None required
'             Early Binding -> Microsoft XML, v6.0
'                              Microsoft ActiveX Data Object X.X Library
'
' Input Variables:
' ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
' sURL          : URL of file to download
' sDownloadPath : Path and filename with extension where to save the downloaded file to
' sUsername     : URL Username, if protected
' sPassword     : URL Password, if protected
' bOverwrite    : Whether or not to overwrite the local file if it already exists
'
' Usage:
' ~~~~~~
' ? XMLHttp_DownloadFile("https://duckduckgo.com/assets/add-to-browser/cppm/laptop.svg", "C:/Temp/laptop.svg")
'   Returns -> True
'
' Revision History:
' Rev       Date(yyyy-mm-dd)        Description
' **************************************************************************************
' 1         2012-07-07              Initial Release
' 2         2022-03-22              Initial Public Release, Forum Help
'                                   Header updated
'                                   Conditional Compilation added for EB and LB
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function XMLHttp_DownloadFile(ByVal sURL As String, _
                                     ByVal sDownloadPath As String, _
                                     Optional ByVal sUsername As String = "", _
                                     Optional ByVal sPassword As String = "", _
                                     Optional bOverwrite As Boolean = True) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Error_Handler
    #Const MSXML_EarlyBind = False
    #Const ADODB_EarlyBind = False
    
    #If MSXML_EarlyBind = True Then
        Dim oXMLHttp          As MSXML2.XMLHTTP60

        Set oXMLHttp = New MSXML2.XMLHTTP60
    #Else
        Dim oXMLHttp          As Object

        Set oXMLHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP.6.0")
    #End If

    #If ADODB_EarlyBind = True Then
        Dim oADODBStream      As ADODB.Stream
        
        Set oADODBStream = New ADODB.Stream
    #Else
        Dim oADODBStream      As Object
        Const adTypeBinary = 1
'        Const adTypeText = 2
        
        Set oADODBStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    #End If

    oXMLHttp.Open "GET", sURL, False, sUsername, sPassword
    oXMLHttp.Send
    If oXMLHttp.Status = 200 Then    'OK
        With oADODBStream
            .Open
            .Type = adTypeBinary
            .Write oXMLHttp.responseBody
            .SaveToFile sDownloadPath, Abs(CInt(bOverwrite)) + 1
        End With
        XMLHttp_DownloadFile = Len(Dir(sDownloadPath)) > 0
    Else
        'Some type of error occurred
        '        oXMLHttp.Status
        '        oXMLHttp.StatusText
    End If

Error_Handler_Exit:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not oADODBStream Is Nothing Then
        oADODBStream.Close
        Set oADODBStream = Nothing
    End If
    If Not oXMLHttp Is Nothing Then Set oXMLHttp = Nothing
    Exit Function

Error_Handler:
    'File doesn't exist, wrong path, ...
    '-2146697211   The system cannot locate the resource specified.
    MsgBox "The following error has occured" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
           "Error Source: XMLHttp_DownloadFile" & vbCrLf & _
           "Error Description: " & Err.Description & _
           Switch(Erl = 0, "", Erl <> 0, vbCrLf & "Line No: " & Erl) _
           , vbOKOnly + vbCritical, "An Error has Occured!"
    Resume Error_Handler_Exit
End Function

Public Sub ReplaceWorkbook()
Dim Folder As String, _
    OldFile As String, _
    NewFile As String, _
    TmpFile As String

    Folder = CurrPath
    OldFile = "DCP_SimulationTool4Clients.old"
    NewFile = "DCP_SimulationTool4Clients.xlsm"
    TmpFile = "DCP_SimulationTool4Clients.tmp"
    
    ' remove the old file
    On Error Resume Next
    Call DeleteFile(OldFile)
    
    ' store the old file with the extension old
    ThisWorkbook.SaveAs Folder & OldFile, FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled
    
    ' close the existing xlsm file, the active is still the old file
    On Error Resume Next
    Workbooks(Folder & NewFile).Close
    
    ' remove the old xlsm file
    On Error Resume Next
    Call DeleteFile(Folder & NewFile)
    
    ' rename the tmp file from the download to the xlsm file
    Name Folder & TmpFile As Folder & NewFile
    
    ' open the new xlsm file
    Workbooks.Open FileName:=Folder & NewFile
    Workbooks(Folder & NewFile).Activate
    
    ' update the information about the version
    With VersionsDict.item("Remote")
        ShtStart.Range("B37").value = .ReleaseVersion: VersionsDict.item("Local").ReleaseVersion = .ReleaseVersion
        ShtStart.Range("C37").value = .ReleaseDate: VersionsDict.item("Local").ReleaseDate = .ReleaseDate
        ShtStart.Range("D37").value = .Ticket: VersionsDict.item("Local").Ticket = .Ticket
        ShtStart.Range("E37").value = .Commit_ID: VersionsDict.item("Local").Commit_ID = .Commit_ID
    End With
    
    Call DeleteFile(Folder & OldFile)
    
    MsgBox "Please restart this application by calling the Excel-Macro", vbInformation
    ThisWorkbook.Close SaveChanges:=True

End Sub

Public Sub Check4Updates(IamDuringStart As Boolean)
Dim Success As Boolean
Dim LocalVersion As String, _
    RemoteVersion As String, _
    MsgBoxAnswer As String
    
    ' Retrieve the version file from the webspace ...
    Success = XMLHttp_DownloadFile(VERSIONFILE, CurrPath & "RemoteVersion.txt")
    
    ' If we've gotten the file then ...
    If Success Then
        ' Analyzing the (remote) file and writing the result into a dictionary
        GetVersion
        
        ' assigning the result of the version comparison to local
        LocalVersion = VersionsDict.item("Local").ReleaseVersion
        frmMain.Caption = MAINTITLE & LocalVersion
        
        ' assigning the result of the version comparison to remote
        RemoteVersion = VersionsDict.item("Remote").ReleaseVersion
        
        ShtStart.Range("B36").value = RemoteVersion
        
        ' check, which of both ones is newer
        If LocalVersion < RemoteVersion Then
        
            ' the remote version is newer, so we show the update button
            frmConfig.cmdDownloadUpdate.Visible = True
            If IamDuringStart Then
                MsgBoxAnswer = MsgBox("We have discovered that there is a newer version of this programme in the ECC webspace." & vbCrLf & _
                                   "Would you like to download this newer version and install it here?", vbQuestion + vbYesNoCancel, "New tool's version detected!")
                Select Case MsgBoxAnswer
                    
                    Case vbYes
                        Success = XMLHttp_DownloadFile(REMOTEMACRO, CurrPath & "DCP_SimulationTool4Clients.tmp")
                        If Success Then
                            ReplaceWorkbook
                        End If
                    
                    Case vbNo
                        OutdatedVersion = True
                        frmMain.Caption = MAINTITLE & LocalVersion & " (but there is a new version in the ECC webspace: Version " & RemoteVersion & ")"
                    
                    Case vbCancel
                        End
                        
                End Select
                
            End If
        
            ' the local version is newer, so we hide the update button
            frmConfig.cmdDownloadUpdate.Visible = False
        End If
    End If
    
End Sub
' Procedure Name: GetVersion
' Purpose: The function reads the version number from the version file in <AppFolder>/lib/<AppName>.version
' Procedure Kind: Function
' Procedure Access: Public
' Return Type: String
' Author: ingmar.pfeiffer
' Date: 12.02.2019
' ----------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetVersion() As String
Dim F As Long
Dim LocalVersionFile As String, _
    VersionLine As String, _
    LogProc As String
Dim FilePath
        
    LogProc = "GetVersion"
    
    LocalVersionFile = CurrPath & "RemoteVersion.txt"
    
    FilePath = Dir(LocalVersionFile)
    
    ' This is for external usage
    If FilePath = vbNullString Then Exit Function
    
    ' this is for internal usage
    If FilePath = vbNullString Then
        Dim errMsg
        errMsg = "Version File doesn't exist"
        MsgBox errMsg
    Else
        Set Vers = New clsVersion
        F = FreeFile
        Open LocalVersionFile For Input As F
        With frmConfig.lblRemoteVersion
            Line Input #F, VersionLine: .Caption = VersionLine & vbCrLf: Vers.ReleaseVersion = Split(VersionLine, ": ")(1)
            Line Input #F, VersionLine: .Caption = .Caption & VersionLine & vbCrLf
            
            Vers.ReleaseDate = WriteLocalDate(Split(VersionLine, ": ")(1))
            If IsThisAUnixTimestamp(Vers.ReleaseDate) Then Vers.ReleaseDate = fromUNIX13Digits(Vers.ReleaseDate)
            
            Line Input #F, VersionLine: .Caption = .Caption & VersionLine: Vers.Commit_ID = Split(VersionLine, " ")(2): Vers.Ticket = Split(VersionLine, " ")(3)
        End With
        If VersionsDict.Exists("Remote") Then
            With VersionsDict.item("Remote")
                .ReleaseVersion = Vers.ReleaseVersion
                .ReleaseDate = Vers.ReleaseDate
                .Commit_ID = Vers.Commit_ID
                .Ticket = Vers.Ticket
            End With
        Else
            VersionsDict.Add "Remote", Vers
        End If
        Close F
    End If
    
    
End Function

Each Direct Clearing Participant (DCP) can assess their settings and optimize them accordingly. The tool allows simulation of trading limits for different times (4 pm, 6 pm, and 9 am) across multiple markets and various calendar dates. Additionally, it provides insights into the impact of different national holidays.
